applySettings.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's settings-type parameters (structure, materials, pens, etc.). Geometry (position, floor, and dimensions such as a Wall's height) is never applied - the element stays on its own home story - except that a Window or Door takes the Favorite's library part and parameters, size included, while keeping its wall, marker and placement. For the hierarchical types (Stair, Railing, Curtain Wall) the settings of the sub-elements are not applied, because they are inseparable from the Favorite's own geometry. A Dimension's text size, text pen and text frame are not changed (tested in Archicad 28): the dimension creation commands take textHeight and textPen for them. Default is true.

applyClassifications.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's classifications. Default is true.

applyCategories.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's element categories (e.g. IFC categories). Default is true.

applyProperties.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's property values. Default is true.

keepFields.description: Fields of the target element to keep: after the Favorite has been applied, they are copied back from the target as it was before, so only the Favorite's other settings (e.g. its library part or wall type) take effect. 'id' and 'layerIndex' apply to every element type; 'width', 'height' and 'sillHeight' to a Window or Door ('width' and 'height' also to a Skylight); 'height', 'topOffset' and 'relativeTopStory' to a Wall or Column; 'referenceLineLocation' to a Wall. A field the target's type does not have is ignored. To keep a Wall's or Column's top exactly as it was, keep 'height', 'relativeTopStory' and 'topOffset' together - a kept 'height' alone is recomputed by Archicad while the Favorite's relativeTopStory links the top to a story. Default: nothing is kept.

coordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the reference line of the curtain wall on the floor plan. Each pair of consecutive coordinates becomes one straight segment, so two coordinates give a single-segment curtain wall.

zCoordinate.description: Optional Z coordinate (absolute elevation) of the bottom of the curtain wall. When omitted, the base level of the favorite (or of the Curtain Wall tool defaults) relative to the floor is kept.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. When omitted, derived from zCoordinate if that is given, otherwise the current story.

height.description: Optional height of the curtain wall. When omitted, the height of the favorite (or of the Curtain Wall tool defaults) is kept.

primaryPattern.description: Optional column pattern: the sizes of the columns along the segment (the primary grid). When omitted, the pattern of the favorite (or of the tool defaults) is kept.

secondaryPattern.description: Optional row pattern: the sizes of the rows from the bottom up (the secondary grid). When omitted, the pattern of the favorite (or of the tool defaults) is kept.

cells.description: Optional assignment of panel and frame classes to the cells of the pattern unit. The unit repeats along and up the segment, so an assignment applies to every repetition of that cell. A cell not listed here keeps the assignment of the favorite (or of the tool defaults) when the pattern is unchanged, otherwise the assignment of the first default cell.

height.description: The height setting stored on the curtain wall element.

actualHeight.description: The height of the curtain wall as calculated by Archicad (ACAPI_CurtainWall_GetCWHeight). Omitted when Archicad cannot calculate it.

angle.description: The rotation angle of the curtain wall in radians.

panelConnectionHole.description: The parameters of the panel connection hole.

d.description: Depth of the panel connection hole.

w.description: Width of the panel connection hole.

frameContour.description: The parameters of the frame contour.

segmentIndex.description: The index of the curtain wall segment to which this frame belongs.

CurtainWallFrameType.description: Enumeration of available curtain wall frame types.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the panel polygon.

isHidden.description: Indicates if the panel is hidden (deleted panels remain in the database).

isDegenerate.description: Indicates if the panel is degenerate. Omitted when Archicad cannot tell.

segmentIndex.description: The index of the curtain wall segment to which this panel belongs.

CurtainWallPattern.description: The column (primary) or row (secondary) pattern of a curtain wall segment: the sizes of the columns/rows of one pattern unit and how the unit is repeated along the segment.

sizes.description: The sizes (widths of the columns or heights of the rows) of the pattern unit in meters, in order from the start of the segment or from the bottom. The unit is repeated to fill the segment.

flexibleIndices.description: Zero-based indices of the columns/rows of the pattern unit that 'BestDivision' may stretch. When omitted, all of them are flexible. Ignored by 'FixedSizes'.

CurtainWallPatternCell.description: The panel and frame classes of one cell of the pattern unit of a curtain wall segment. Panel classes are numbered as Archicad numbers them: 0 is no panel (the cell is left empty), 1 is the first panel class of the curtain wall (as listed in the Curtain Wall Settings, from the favorite or the tool defaults), 2 the second and so on. Frame classes: 0 is no frame (the cell is merged with its neighbour), 1 the Division frame, 2 the Corner frame, 3 the Boundary frame, 4 the first custom frame class of the curtain wall, 5 the second and so on. Fields not given keep the default assignment of the cell.

columnIndex.description: Zero-based column of the cell within the pattern unit, counted from the start of the segment.

rowIndex.description: Zero-based row of the cell within the pattern unit, counted from the bottom.

panelClassIndex.description: The panel class of the cell. 0 leaves the cell without a panel (Archicad keeps a hidden 'deleted panel' subelement there). With a crossing frame it is the class of the left (or lower) half; see rightPanelClassIndex for the other half.

rightPanelClassIndex.description: The panel class of the right (or upper) half of a cell with a crossing frame. Defaults to panelClassIndex.

leftFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the frame on the left edge of the cell (the grid line at the start of the column).

bottomFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the frame on the bottom edge of the cell (the grid line at the bottom of the row).

crossingFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the diagonal frame of the cell. Only used when crossingFrameType is not 'None'.

CurtainWallPatternLogic.description: How the pattern unit fills the segment: 'FixedSizes' keeps the given sizes and repeats the unit, which may leave a partial unit at the end (Archicad: Fixed Size); 'BestDivision' stretches the flexible columns/rows so that whole units fill the segment with the least stretching (Archicad: Best Division).

CurtainWallPatternOrigin.description: Where the pattern unit is anchored on the segment: at its start, centered with a unit starting at the center, centered with a unit centered on the center, or at its end.

gridAngle.description: The angle of the grid in radians.

isNegativeArc.description: Indicates if the arc is negative.

coordinates.description: The new 2D coordinates of the reference line of the curtain wall on the floor plan. Each pair of consecutive coordinates is one straight segment, so the number of coordinates must be the current number of segments plus one: the segments can be moved and resized, but not added or removed (a curved segment becomes straight).

zCoordinate.description: The new Z coordinate (absolute elevation) of the bottom of the curtain wall. The home story is derived from it unless floorIndex is given too.

floorIndex.description: The new home story index. On its own it moves the curtain wall to that story, keeping its bottom offset from the story; with zCoordinate it pins the story the bottom elevation is measured from.

height.description: The new height of the curtain wall.

primaryPattern.description: The new column pattern: the sizes of the columns along the segments (the primary grid). Applied to every segment of the curtain wall; the frames and panels are regenerated from it.

secondaryPattern.description: The new row pattern: the sizes of the rows from the bottom up (the secondary grid). Applied to every segment of the curtain wall; the frames and panels are regenerated from it.

cells.description: Assignment of panel and frame classes to the cells of the pattern unit of every segment, as in CreateCurtainWalls. Without a pattern change, a cell not listed here keeps its current assignment; with one, it takes the assignment of the first current cell.

CutPlane.description: Defines a 3D cut plane using the plane equation: pa*x + pb*y + pc*z + pd = 0

pa.description: Coefficient of x in the plane equation. The x coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pb.description: Coefficient of y in the plane equation. The y coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pc.description: Coefficient of z in the plane equation. The z coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pd.description: Constant term in the plane equation, in meters. The distance of the plane from the origin along the normal vector.

databaseId.description: The database to activate. When windowType is omitted, the window type is taken from the database; when both are given, they must match.

storyIndex.description: Story index to activate. Only valid when windowType is 'FloorPlan'. As returned by GetStories.

databaseId.description: The database to activate. When windowType is omitted, the window type is taken from the database; when both are given, they must match.

storyIndex.description: Story index to activate. Only valid when windowType is 'FloorPlan'. As returned by GetStories.

name.description: The name of the database. Missing when the database info cannot be read.

referenceId.description: The reference id of the database. Missing when the database info cannot be read.

DatabaseIdOrError.description: An Archicad database identifier or an error.

DatabaseIdsOrErrors.description: A list of Archicad database identifiers or errors.

Date.description: A date in its string representation as defined in ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD.

categoryValueId.description: Left out when the default has no value in this category.

name.description: The localized name of the value, for display only. Left out when the default has no value in this category.

available.description: Whether the property is available for the tool default of the element type.

visible.description: Whether the property is visible for the tool default of the element type.

designOptionCombinations.description: The design option combinations to delete.

designOptionSets.description: The design option sets to delete.

electricalCircuits.description: The circuits to remove from their panels.

elementSets.description: The element sets to delete, as returned by CreateElementSets or GetElementSetsOfElements. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On can be deleted. The elements of a deleted set are not deleted.

elements.description: The elements to delete. The zones among them are deleted before all the others, so an automatic zone deleted together with its bounding elements is gone before its boundary is. Deleting the boundary of an automatic zone without the zone itself can open Archicad's modal 'No closed polygon found around the clicked point' dialog, which blocks the command until someone clicks it in Archicad.

embeddedLibraryItems.description: A list of embedded library items to delete.

path.description: The relative path of the library item inside the embedded library, the same path AddFilesToEmbeddedLibrary takes as outputPath.
The path of the folder to delete, in the format GetFavoriteFolders returns: the folder names from the root down. The root folder cannot be deleted.

recursive.description: Archicad deletes a folder together with everything in it: its Favorites and its subfolders with their Favorites. A folder that is not empty is deleted only if this is true. Default: false.

databases.description: The parent databases whose trace (ghost) record is deleted, as returned by GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId or GetContainingDatabases.

graphicOverrideCombinationIds.description: The graphic override combinations to delete. Their rules are kept.

ruleGroupNames.description: The names of the rule groups to delete.

moveRulesToGroup.description: The name of the rule group the rules of the deleted groups are moved to, so they are kept. Created when no rule group has this name.

deleteRules.description: Delete the rules of the deleted groups too. Without this or moveRulesToGroup, a group that still contains rules is not deleted.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The graphic override rules to delete.

hotlinkNodes.description: The hotlink nodes to delete, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes. Each node is removed together with its placed instances and their elements, as the Hotlink Manager's Delete does; use BreakHotlinkNodes instead to keep the elements. In Teamwork the Hotlink and XRef management has to be reserved first (ReserveHotlinkCacheManagement).

acceptAllElements.description: Accept all creation/deletion/modification of the deleted issue. By default false.

physicalSystems.description: The physical systems to remove from their system groups. Their member elements are not deleted.

tableId.description: The guid of a preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables (the branch, elbow and transition tables with includeFittingTables): a pipe or circular duct segment table, a branch or elbow table of the Piping or Ventilation domain, or, from Archicad 29, a transition table. Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables are found too, but their rows have no key. Archicad 27: any preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers.

keys.description: The keys of the rows to delete. Segment tables, and the elbow tables of Archicad 28, have a row for each reference id, which is emptied instead. Archicad 27: the indices are those before the call; the rows are deleted from the highest index down.

items.description: The key of a row. Segment tables: referenceId. Elbow tables: referenceId and angle. Branch tables: mainAxisReferenceId, branchAxisReferenceId and branchAxisAngle. Transition tables: beginReferenceId and endReferenceId. The angles are as GetMEPPreferenceTables returns them; Archicad 28 finds the rows by their reference ids only and rejects a key with an angle. Archicad 27: shape and index (AddMEPPreferenceTableRows: shape only).

names.description: The names of the project data to delete.

projectInfoIds.description: List of project info field ids to delete. Only custom fields (ids starting with 'autotext-') can be deleted.

projectInfoGroups.description: The Project Info groups to delete. A group that contains fixed (built-in) fields cannot be deleted.

propertyIds.description: The identifiers of properties to delete.

propertyGroupIds.description: The identifiers of property groups to delete.

executionResults.description: One result per attribute, in the input order.

name.description: The name of the design option combination.

activeDesignOptions.description: The list of active design options in the combination.

designOptionCombinationId.description: The guid identifier of the design option combination.

name.description: The name of the design option combination.

activeDesignOptions.description: The list of active design options in the combination. Available from Archicad 29.

isEditable.description: Whether the design option combination can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork). Available from Archicad 29.

notEditableError.description: The reason why the design option combination is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

designOptions.description: The design options to turn off in the combination. The other options of the combination are left as they are.

notEditableError.description: The reason why the design option is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

DesignOptionId.description: The identifier of a design option.

designOptionId.description: The design option to move within its set.

beforeDesignOptionId.description: The design option of the same set to move it before. When it is not given, the design option is moved to the end of its set.

canMove.description: Whether the element can be moved to another design option or to the main model.

error.description: The reason why the element cannot be moved. Only present when canMove is false.

name.description: The new name of the design option. The name is kept when it is not given.

id.description: The new string id of the design option. The id is kept when it is not given.

DesignOptionSetId.description: The identifier of a design option set.

designOptionSetId.description: The design option set to move.

beforeDesignOptionSetId.description: The design option set to move it before. When it is not given, the set is moved to the end.

name.description: The new name of the design option set.

angle.description: The rotation angle (radian) of the marker symbol

clipPolygon.description: The clip polygon of the detail/worksheet

referredView.description: Guid of the referred view. Only if the marker refers to a view.

referredDrawing.description: Guid of the referred drawing. Only if the marker refers to a drawing.

referredPMViewPoint.description: Guid of the referred view point. Only if the marker refers to a view point.

DetailsOfElement.description: Details of an element. When the optional fields filter is given in the input, only the requested fields are present; the required list below applies to unfiltered requests.

hotlinkId.description: The hotlink instance this element belongs to. Present only for elements that came in through a placed hotlink; such elements are read-only.

floorPlanPolygons.description: Cut-fill polygons as drawn on the floor plan (wall joins resolved by ArchiCAD). Only collected for construction element types whose floor plan symbol comes from a real cut through the element - walls, columns, beams and their segments, slabs, roofs, shells, meshes, morphs, curtain walls and their segments/panels/frames, stairs and their risers/treads/structures. Absent for every other type, when the element has no cut fill, or when the floor plan database is not accessible.

DimensionData.description: Dimension element data including witness points and geometry.

witnessPoints.description: The witness points of the dimension. Besides the geometry each item carries the base element reference as CreateAssociativeDimensions takes it (API_Base: baseElementId, line, inIndex, special, nodeType, nodeStatus, nodeId): read a dimension placed by hand to learn the values an element type needs.

DimensionOrigin.description: The origin a level dimension measures from.

DimensionPreferences.description: The Dimensions page: the dimension standard and the format (unit, decimals, extra accuracy and zero handling) of each dimension type.

dimensionStandardIndex.description: The index of the dimension standard the page follows.

radial.description: The format of the radial dimensions.

level.description: The format of the level dimensions.

elevation.description: The format of the elevation dimensions.

doorWindow.description: The format of the door, window and skylight dimensions.

parapet.description: The format of the sill height (parapet) dimensions.

DimensionPreferencesUpdate.description: The Dimensions page: the dimension standard and the format (unit, decimals, extra accuracy and zero handling) of each dimension type.

index.description: The 1-based index of the dimension standard.

name.description: The name of the dimension standard, as the dimensionStyle of GetViewSettings and SetViewSettings.

DisplayValueEnumId.description: An enumeration value identifier using the displayed value.

Document3DAttributeOptions.description: The uniform attribute options (cut and uncut surfaces, shading, hidden edges).

shouldUseUniformCutAttributes.description: Use uniform attributes on the cut surfaces.

uniformLineType.description: The index of the uniform line type of the cut surfaces.

uniformFillPen.description: The uniform fill pen of the cut surfaces.

uniformFillBkgPen.description: The uniform fill background pen of the cut surfaces.

uncutSurfaceBkgPen.description: The background pen of the uncut surfaces.

shouldUseElemPen.description: Use a uniform pen for the element contours.

elemPen.description: The uniform pen of the element contours.

shadFillPen.description: The pen of the shadow fill.

shadFill.description: The index of the shadow fill.

shadFillBkgPen.description: The background pen of the shadow fill.

shadContPen.description: The pen of the shadow contours.

hiddenEdgeLineType.description: The index of the line type of the hidden edges.

hiddenEdgeLinePen.description: The pen of the hidden edges.

Document3DBoundaryDisplay.description: How the boundary contours are displayed.

Document3DPlanConnection.description: The connection of the 3D Document to the model.

changes.description: All changes belonging to the given document revision.

DocumentRevisionId.description: The identifier of a document revision.

DocumentRevisionReference.description: A reference to a document revision belonging to the current issue

DocumentRevisionReferences.description: All document revisions belong to the current issue.

libraryPartName.description: Optional. Localized library part name (docu_UName) to place instead of the tool default/favorite, e.g. a shutter part that has no favorite. It has to be a door library part. Applied to the tool defaults before cloning.

favoriteName.description: Optional. Name of an existing Door favorite (as returned by `GetFavoritesByType`). Applied to the Door tool defaults before the create.

reveal.description: Turn the reveal on or off.

revealDepthOffset.description: Distance the frame plane is moved across the wall thickness, along the wall normal.

contentBox.description: The full boundary box of the Drawing's content, independent of its frame, as returned by Archicad.

name.description: Custom title name of the new Drawing. Giving a name implies nameType CustomName unless nameType is set explicitly.

nameType.description: Defaults to CustomName when name is given, otherwise to the Drawing tool's current default.

scale.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view (API_DrawingType::ratio). Defaults to 1.0.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians. Defaults to the Drawing tool's current default.

drawingScale.description: The nominal scale of the drawing. Defaults to the Drawing tool's current default.

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing. Defaults to the Drawing tool's current default.

clipPolygon.description: Optional polygon to clip the drawing with, in layout coordinates (meters on the layout, the same coordinate system as position) - not the coordinates of the source view's model. Stored as given: position, angle, scale and modelOffset are not applied to it.

pos.description: Position of the drawing's reference point on the layout.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians.

ratio.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view.

drawingScale.description: The nominal scale of the drawing.

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing.

isCutWithFrame.description: Whether the drawing is clipped by a custom polygon (see clipPolygon) instead of showing the full auto-fit extent.

bounds.description: Bounds of the drawing on the layout.

clipPolygon.description: Polygon used to clip the drawing view, in layout coordinates (meters on the layout, the same coordinate system as pos and bounds - not the coordinates of the source view's model). Archicad stores it as is; pos, angle, ratio and modelOffset are not applied to it. Present only when isCutWithFrame is true.

navigatorItemId.description: Archicad's internal identifier of this Drawing's link (API_DrawingType::drawingGuid as Archicad reports it). This is NOT the navigator item id of the source view: CreateDrawings passes the source view in this field, but once the Drawing is created Archicad reports its own identifier, which is different for every Drawing (even two Drawings of the same view), is neither the source view nor the Drawing's item in the Layout Book, and is not accepted by navigator commands such as GetViewSettings. To find the source view of a placed Drawing, use the sourceNavigatorItemId of its DrawingItem in the Layout Book tree (GetNavigatorItemTree). Read-only: Archicad has no API to relink a Drawing to a different source (see ChangeDrawingLink).

customName.description: The drawing's custom title name. Present only when nameType is CustomName.

customNumber.description: The drawing's custom title ID. Present only when numberingType is CustomNumber.

isInNumbering.description: Whether the drawing is included in the automatic drawing numbering sequence.

isScaleIncludedInAutotextAndIndex.description: The 'Include scale in Autotext and index' checkbox of Drawing Settings (API_DrawingType::includeInAutoTextsAndIES): whether the drawing's scale is included in the 'Drawing Scale' and 'Original Scale' Autotexts and in indexes.

hasBorderLine.description: Whether the drawing shows a printable border (Drawing Settings > Frame > Add Printable Border).

borderLineTypeIndex.description: Attribute index of the line type of the drawing's border.

borderPenIndex.description: Pen index of the drawing's border.

borderSize.description: Border size of the drawing (API_DrawingType::borderSize), in meters.

titleLibraryPartIndex.description: Library part index of the drawing title (API_DrawingTitle::libInd). A negative/invalid index means no title object is instantiated; setting it to a valid index (e.g. copied from another drawing) makes Archicad create the title's own placed element.

titleElementId.description: Id of the drawing title, itself a placed GDL object element (font/pen/size aside, its own settings are reachable like any other element, e.g. with GetGDLParametersOfElements/SetGDLParametersOfElements). Absent if the drawing has no title object.

DrawingNameType.description: How the drawing's title name is assembled (Identification tabpage of the Drawing Settings dialog).

endC.description: The end point of the line, in layout coordinates.

penIndex.description: The index of the pen of the line.

lineTypeIndex.description: The index of the line type of the line.

pen.description: The pen index of the primitive.

lineType.description: Line, Arc, PLine, Tri and Poly: the line type.

determination.description: How the type of the line or fill is determined (origin, inner line, contour line).

loc.description: Point: the location. Text: the left baseline position.

nArcs.description: The number of curved segments. Their geometry is not returned.

coordinates.description: PLine: the vertices. Tri: the three corners.

polygons.description: Poly: the sub polygons, the first one is the outline, the others are holes.

destBox.description: Pict: the bounding box of the picture.

DrawingPrimitiveType.description: The API_PrimTypeID name without its API_Prim prefix and ID suffix.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians.

ratio.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view.

drawingScale.description: The nominal scale of the drawing. Archicad may keep the existing value of a placed Drawing; the element's execution result is then a failure that names the value kept, although the other settings given were applied.

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing.

isCutWithFrame.description: Whether the drawing is clipped by a custom polygon. Set to false to clear an existing crop and restore the drawing's full auto-fit extent. Only consulted when no clipPolygon is supplied in the same call - supplying a clipPolygon always enables clipping. Setting it to true without a clipPolygon merely re-enables the clip polygon already stored on the Drawing.

clipPolygon.description: Polygon used to clip the drawing view, in layout coordinates (meters on the layout, the same coordinate system as pos and bounds - not the coordinates of the source view's model). It is stored as given: pos, angle, ratio and modelOffset are not applied to it, so a polygon taken from the model must be transformed to the layout first. At least 3 points. Setting this also enables polygon clipping (isCutWithFrame becomes true); to remove clipping, set isCutWithFrame to false instead.

customNumber.description: The drawing's custom title ID. Only used when numberingType is CustomNumber.

isScaleIncludedInAutotextAndIndex.description: The 'Include scale in Autotext and index' checkbox of Drawing Settings (API_DrawingType::includeInAutoTextsAndIES): whether the drawing's scale is included in the 'Drawing Scale' and 'Original Scale' Autotexts and in indexes. Set it to false on e.g. a 1:1 schedule drawing placed next to a 1:200 plan so that the layout's scale Autotext shows only 1:200.

hasBorderLine.description: Whether the drawing shows a printable border (Drawing Settings > Frame > Add Printable Border).

borderLineTypeIndex.description: Attribute index of the line type of the drawing's border.

borderPenIndex.description: Pen index of the drawing's border.

orientation.description: Defaults to the direction (1, 0, 0) and the rotation (0, 1, 0).

libraryPartId.description: The library part to use, as listed by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

xSize.description: The size along the local x axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

ySize.description: The size along the local y axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

ElectricalPanelDetails.description: The details of an electrical panel (distribution board).

circuitNamePrefix.description: The prefix of the names of the circuits of the panel.

circuitIdStyle.description: The index of the style of the circuit ids.

circuits.description: The circuits owned by the panel.

parentCircuitId.description: The circuit the panel is connected to. Missing when the panel is not connected to a circuit.

anchorPoint.description: The anchor point of the element.

rotation.description: The base rotation of the element in radians.

libraryPartId.description: The library part of the element.

xSize.description: The size of the element along its local x axis.

ySize.description: The size of the element along its local y axis.

ElectricalPanelDetailsOrError.description: The details of an electrical panel or an error.

libraryPartId.description: The library part to use, as listed by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

xSize.description: The size along the local x axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

ySize.description: The size along the local y axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

crossSectionalArea.description: The cross-sectional area of the wire in square millimeters.

bodies.description: The bodies of the element's 3D model generated with separate components: a composite structure has one body per skin. Empty when the element has no 3D model.

name.description: The localized name of the category, for display only.

values.description: The possible values of the category.

ElementCategoryId.description: The identifier of an element category.

ElementCategoryType.description: The type of an element category. The names of the categories and of their values are localized, so scripts should select a category by this type and a value by its categoryValueId, never by name. BRI is available only in the German localized version of Archicad.

name.description: The localized name of the value, for display only.

categoryValueId.description: A value of the category given by type, as GetElementCategories lists them.

name.description: The localized name of the value, for display only.

isVisibleOnUI.description: The value is offered in the settings dialogs of Archicad.

usableAsCriteria.description: The value can be used as a criterion, for example in Find & Select and in Graphic Override rules.

ElementCategoryValueId.description: The identifier of a value of an element category.

ElementClassificationItemArray.description: A wrapper containing a list of element classification identifiers or errors.

ElementClassifications.description: A list of element classification identifiers.

ElementClassificationsOrErrors.description: A list of element classification identifiers or errors.

projectedArea.description: Projected area of the skin. Archicad reports 0 when the legacy intersection and surface calculation is turned on in the Project Preferences.

isCore.description: The skin is marked as core.

isFinish.description: The skin is marked as finish.

subElementId.description: The sub-element (for example a column or beam segment) the skin belongs to. Present only when Archicad attaches the skin to a sub-element.

polygons.description: The polygons of the surface where the two elements touch, in world coordinates. The last point of a polygon repeats its first.

convexPolygons.description: With convex: true, the convex polygons the faces of the element's 3D model are decomposed into, body by body and face by face. Empty (or an error item instead) when the element has no solid 3D model of its own (the bodies of a Stair, Railing or Curtain Wall, and of the segments of a Column or Beam, belong to their subelements, which can be given instead).

ElementCutPlane.description: The cutting plane. axisX, axisY and axisZ should be unit vectors perpendicular to each other; axisZ is the normal of the plane.

basePoint.description: A point of the plane, the origin of the returned 2D coordinates.

axisX.description: The direction of the x axis of the returned 2D coordinates.

axisY.description: The direction of the y axis of the returned 2D coordinates.

bodies.description: The bodies of the element's 3D model generated with separate components: a composite structure has one body per skin. Empty when the element has no 3D model.

libraryPartIndex.description: The index of the library part that declares the descriptor, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

name.description: The name of the library part. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

guid.description: The guid of the library part, the same as the guid returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

setIndex.description: The index of the listing database set of the descriptor. Meaningful only when status is Normal.

index.description: The index of the descriptor in the listing database set when status is Normal, in the library part when status is Local.

ElementDescriptorStatus.description: Normal: the descriptor exists in the listing database. Deleted: it is referenced, but deleted from the database. Local: it is defined in the library part. Unknown for a value this version of Tapir does not name.

descriptors.description: The descriptors in the property objects of the element. Empty when the element has none.

ElementDetailsField.description: A field of the details of an element.

primitives.description: The primitives in the order Archicad draws them. The Ctrl_* items mark the beginning and the end of sub-parts (hatch borders, hatch lines, texts, curtain wall panels, ...).

ElementFilter.description: A filter type for an element.

bodies.description: The solid bodies of the element's 3D model, including those of its subelements for a Stair, Railing or Curtain Wall, and of its segments for a Column or Beam. Empty when the element has no solid 3D model (for example a 2D element, or one filtered out of the 3D view).

ElementGroupParameters.description: The parameters for creating a single group

elements.description: The elements or child groups to be grouped.

parentGroupId.description: Optional parent group ID to nest this group under.

ElementHeaderFromOtherDatabase.description: An element that is not in the current database but in another one (a layout, a section, a worksheet ...). Only the fields of its element header are returned: no id, details or floorPlanPolygons. Use GetContainingDatabases and ChangeWindow to open its database and read its full details.

hotlinkId.description: The hotlink instance this element belongs to. Present only for elements that came in through a placed hotlink.

fromOtherDatabase.description: Always true: the element is not in the current database.

hotspots.description: The 2D hotspots of the placed library part instance, as Archicad returns them.

ElementIFCAttribute.description: An IFC attribute of an element, for example Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, PredefinedType or LongName.

name.description: The name of the IFC attribute.

valueType.description: The IFC type of the value, for example IfcLabel, IfcText or IfcIdentifier.

value.description: The value of the IFC attribute. Missing when the attribute has no value.

name.description: The name of the IFC attribute, for example Name, Description, ObjectType or Tag. It must be one of the attributes GetIFCAttributesOfElements returns for the element.

value.description: The new value of the IFC attribute.

ElementIFCAttributes.description: The IFC attributes of an element.

ElementIFCAttributesOrErrors.description: A list of the IFC attributes of elements or errors.

ElementIFCClassificationReference.description: An IFC classification reference (IfcClassificationReference) of an element. The text fields are missing when the reference has no value for them.

identification.description: The identification of the classification reference, for example a classification code.

name.description: The name of the classification reference.

location.description: The location of the classification reference, for example a URL.

description.description: The description of the classification reference. Given from Archicad 29.

name.description: The name of the classification reference. Default: empty.

location.description: The location of the classification reference, for example a URL. Default: empty.

ElementIFCClassificationReferences.description: The IFC classification references of an element.

ElementIFCClassificationReferencesOrErro.description: Element IFC classification references or error.
A list of the IFC classification references of elements or errors.

ElementIFCIds.description: The IFC identifiers of an element.

ifcId.description: The IFC identifier of the element. From Archicad 28 it is the IFC GlobalId (22 characters); before Archicad 28 it is the same identifier in the 36 character GUID form, and ifcGlobalId gives its GlobalId.

externalIFCId.description: The external IFC identifier of the element, in the same form as ifcId.

ifcGlobalId.description: The IFC GlobalId (22 characters) of ifcId. Only returned before Archicad 28, where ifcId is in the GUID form; from Archicad 28 ifcId already is the GlobalId.

externalIFCGlobalId.description: The IFC GlobalId (22 characters) of externalIFCId, empty when the element has no external IFC identifier. Only returned before Archicad 28.

ElementIFCIdsOrErrors.description: A list of the IFC identifiers of elements or errors.

ElementIFCProperties.description: The IFC properties of an element.

ElementIFCPropertiesOrErrors.description: A list of the IFC properties of elements or errors.

ElementIFCProperty.description: The details of an IFC property value of an element.

value.description: The value of the property as a string. List and enumerated values are separated by semicolons.

valueType.description: The IFC type of the value, for example IfcLabel or IfcLengthMeasure. For a table value it is the type of its defined values. Left out when the property has no value to take the type from.

propertySetName.description: The name of the property set, for example Pset_DoorCommon.

propertyName.description: The name of the property, for example FireRating.

ElementIFCType.description: The IFC type of an element.

ElementIFCTypesOrErrors.description: A list of the IFC types of elements or errors.

ElementIdOrError.description: An element identifier or an error.

ElementIdsOrErrors.description: A list of element identifiers or errors.

infoString.description: The new Element ID, as the Info Box shows it (GetDetailsOfElements returns it as id).

libraryPart.description: The new library part, given by one of name, index or guid. It has to be a placeable library part of the element's type in the loaded libraries.

keepParameters.description: Copies the values of the element's GDL parameters to the parameters of the new library part that have the same name, type and array dimensions; the other parameters get the new part's defaults. Default: true.

keepSize.description: Keeps the size (A and B) of the element; when false, the element gets the new part's default size. Default: true.

ElementLinkData.description: A directional link from one element to another, with the flags stored on it.

fromElementId.description: The element the link starts from.

toElementId.description: The element the link points to.

flags.description: A 32-bit integer stored on the link, free for the script's own use (for example to tell apart the kinds of links it creates). Default is 0.

elementId.description: The element the link points to.

flags.description: The flags stored on the link by LinkElements.

ElementLinkReference.description: A directional link from one element to another.

fromElementId.description: The element the link starts from.

toElementId.description: The element the link points to.

linkByCriteria.description: True when the property objects matching their criteria are linked to the element.

individualLibraryPartIndex.description: The index of the library part of the individually assigned property object, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. 0 when no property object is assigned individually.

individualLibraryPartName.description: The name of the individually assigned library part. Absent when there is none or it cannot be read.

individualLibraryPartGuid.description: The guid of the individually assigned library part, the same as the guid returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Absent when there is none or it cannot be read.

criteriaPropertyObjects.description: The linked property objects whose criteria match the element.

links.description: The links starting from the element.

ElementLinksOrError.description: The links starting from an element, or an error.

elbowParameters.description: The elbow parameters of a routing node (RoutingNode::Modifier::SetElbowDefaultParameters). Archicad 29 or newer.

transitionParameters.description: The transition parameters of a routing node (RoutingNode::Modifier::SetTransitionDefaultParameters). Archicad 29 or newer.

mirrorAxis.description: The mirror axis: the line through two points on the floor plan.

beginPoint.description: First point of the mirror axis.

endPoint.description: Second point of the mirror axis. Must differ from beginPoint.

copy.description: Optional parameter. If true, a mirrored copy of the element is created and the original is kept. By default it's false.

ElementOrGroupId.description: An identifier representing either an Element or a Group.

ElementOrGroupIds.description: A list of element and/or group identifiers.

libraryPartIndex.description: The index of the property object's library part, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

name.description: The name of the library part. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

guid.description: The guid of the library part, the same as the guid returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

isIndividuallyAssigned.description: True when the property object is assigned to the element individually, false when it is linked by criteria.

propertyObjects.description: The property objects (library parts of the old listing system) of the element, linked to it by criteria or individually. Empty when the element has none.

ElementPropertyValue.description: A property value with the identifiers of the property and its owner element.

ElementPropertyValues.description: A list of element property values.

ElementQuantities.description: The type-specific quantities of an element. The fields depend on the type of the element.

composites.description: The quantities per building material, in the order Archicad reports them: one item for each skin of a composite or complex profile element, and a single item for a basic element. Empty for Zones and Morphs, for which Archicad reports no skins.

ElementRelationsOrError.description: The type-specific relations of an element or an error. The variant depends on the type of the input element.

ElementReservationState.description: Free: nobody has reserved the element. Editable: the current user has reserved it. Locked: another user has reserved it (see reservedBy).

elements.description: The elements to put into the element set.
The elements of the element set.

ElementSetId.description: The identifier of an element set.

ElementSetUserData.description: The custom data stored with the element set by the add-on that created it.

dataVersion.description: The version of the data, as set by the add-on that created the element set.

platformSign.description: The platform sign of the data, telling the byte order it was written with.

data.description: The raw bytes of the data, Base64 encoded. Empty when the element set has no data.

elementSets.description: The element sets that contain the element. Empty if the element is not part of any element set.

elementSetId.description: The identifier of an element set.

ElementStateId.description: The identifier of the captured state, accepted by GetElementChangesSince and ReleaseElementState. It is only valid in the Archicad session and project it was captured in.

ElementStateType.description: How GetElementChangesSince finds the changed elements between this state and another one. ModificationStamp (the default) compares the modification stamps of the elements, so any change to an element counts. 3DModel compares the 3D model of the elements, so only a change that alters the 3D model counts, and capturing it generates the 3D model of the project. Two states can only be compared when they were captured with the same type.

surfaces.description: The surfaces of the element as Archicad reports them: one item per surface attribute and building material pair of the element, so an element has as many items as it has distinct pairs (a basic wall with three different surfaces reports three items). Empty when Archicad reports no surface for the element, for example for an element without a 3D model.

surfaceId.description: The surface (material) attribute of the surface. Left out when the surface is not a project attribute, for example one defined by a GDL script.

buildingMaterialId.description: The building material of the part of the element the surface belongs to.

exposedArea.description: The area of the surface that is not covered by any of the covering elements, in square meters.

bodyIndex.description: The index of the body in the element, starting from 0.

polygonIndex.description: The index of the polygon in the body, starting from 0.

polygonId.description: The identifier of the polygon in the 3D model (ModelerAPI::Polygon::GetPolygonId).

surfaceType.description: The surface type of the polygon: the numeric value of API_SurfaceTypeID as ACAPI_Polygon_PolygonId2SurfaceType returns it.

polygons.description: Every polygon of every body of the element's 3D model, generated with separate components. Empty when the element has no 3D model.

bodies.description: The solid bodies of the element's own 3D model, in Archicad's order, or an error for a body without texture information. Empty (or an error item instead) when the element has no solid 3D model of its own (the bodies of a Stair, Railing or Curtain Wall, and of the segments of a Column or Beam, belong to their subelements, which can be given instead).

triangles.description: The triangles covering the polygon of the element, holes excluded, as Archicad triangulates it.

vertices.description: The 2D coordinates of the three vertices of the triangle.

ElementTrims.description: The trims of one element: the roofs and shells trimming it, and the elements it trims.

trimmedBy.description: The roofs and shells trimming this element, with the trim type.

trims.description: The elements this roof or shell trims.

ElementTrimsOrError.description: The trims of one element, or an error.

name.description: The name of the element type in the language of the running Archicad (for example "Wand" for Wall in German Archicad).

url.description: The URL of the link, e.g. https://www.graphisoft.com.

description.description: The description of the link, e.g. GRAPHISOFT Home Page.

userData.description: The key-value pairs stored on the element.

value.description: The stored value.

markerParameters.description: The marker parameters to change, each given by name or by index. The other marker parameters and the opening's own settings are left as they are.

ElementsWithExecutionResults.description: The response of the GetElementsByType command.

ElementsWrapper.description: A list of elements wrapped in an object.

ElementsWrapperOrError.description: A list of elements or an error.

path.description: The absolute path of the file to copy.

EndpointConnections.description: The connections of a wall, beam or beam segment.

connectedToBeginPoint.description: Elements connected to the beginning point of the element.

connectedToEndPoint.description: Elements connected to the end point of the element.

connectedWithReferenceLineToEndPoints.description: Elements connected with their reference line to the beginning or end point of the element.

connectedToReferenceLine.description: Elements connected to the reference line of the element, not at its endpoints.

crossingReferenceLine.description: Elements whose reference line intersects the reference line of the element.

guid.description: The identifier of the enumeration value, as reported by GetAllProperties. An element's stored value refers to the value by this.

nonLocalizedValue.description: Nonlocalized value of the enumeration if there is one.

EnumValueIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the identifier of a property enumeration value.

nonLocalizedValue.description: Nonlocalized value of the enumeration if there is one.

names.description: Optional subset of Favorites to export. Default: export all.

issues.description: Leave it empty to export all issues.

exportPath.description: The os path to the bcf file, including it's name.

useExternalId.description: Use external IFC ID or Archicad IFC ID as referenced in BCF topics.

alignBySurveyPoint.description: Align BCF views by Archicad Survey Point or Archicad Project Origin.

ExpressionDefaultValue.description: Default value of the property in case of an expression based property value.

FailedExecutionResult.description: The result of a failed execution.

FavoriteConflictPolicy.description: What to do when a Favorite with this name already exists: Error fails, Skip leaves the existing Favorite unchanged, OverwriteExisting gives the existing Favorite the new settings (its folder does not change), RenameNew creates the Favorite with ' (2)', ' (3)', ... appended to the name. Default Error.

FavoriteCreationOutcome.description: Created for a new Favorite (also with RenameNew), Skipped or Overwritten when a Favorite with the name already existed.

elementType.description: The element type of the favorite, as in GetFavoritesByType.

classifications.description: The classifications the favorite applies, one per classification system.

properties.description: The property values stored in the favorite.

categoryValues.description: The element category values (e.g. Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status) stored in the favorite.

FavoriteExportFormat.description: The format to export to. prefs (the default) works in every Archicad version. xml exports each Favorite to its own file in the folder, and legacyPRF exports to a Favorites file of earlier Archicad versions; these two require Archicad 29 or newer.

FavoriteFolderDetails.description: A folder of the Favorites palette with its Favorites and subfolders recursively.

name.description: The name of the folder. Empty for the root folder.

path.description: The names of the folders leading from the root to this folder, this folder's name last. Empty for the root folder.

favorites.description: The names of the Favorites directly in this folder.

isDefault.description: True if the value is the default value of the property.

folder.description: The folder hierarchy of the Favorite in the Favorites palette. Empty for the root.

libPart.description: The library part of the Favorite, for the library part based types (Object, Lamp, Window, Door, Skylight, Zone). Absent otherwise or when it could not be read.

subElements.description: The sub-elements stored with the Favorite.

toolDefault.description: Take the current settings of this tool.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing Fill with the given name will be overwritten.

subType.description: Vector, Solid, Empty, Symbol, LinearGradient, RadialGradient, or Image. Defaults to Vector. Only one Solid and one Empty fill may exist. Image fills use the texture field's name to reference the image library part.

useForWalls.description: This fill can be used for cut fills.

useForDraft.description: This fill can be used for drafting fills.

useForCover.description: This fill can be used for cover fills.

horizontalSpacing.description: The fill's spacing factor in the X direction (Vector fills).

verticalSpacing.description: The fill's spacing factor in the Y direction (Vector fills).

angle.description: The angle of the fill in radians (Vector, Symbol, and gradient fills).

bitPattern.description: 16 hex characters (8 bytes) describing the fill's bitmap pattern, one line of the pattern per byte, matching the Pattern field of the Attribute Manager XML export.

symbolOffset1.description: First offset vector of the repeating symbol motif, X1/Y1 in the Fill Types dialog (Symbol fills only).

symbolOffset2.description: Second offset vector of the repeating symbol motif, X2/Y2 in the Fill Types dialog (Symbol fills only).

percent.description: Translucency percentage [0..1] (gradient and some Solid fills).

texture.description: Used for Image and gradient fills. Only name, rotationAngle, xSize, ySize, mirrorX, and mirrorY are used for Fills.

lineItems.description: Vectorial fill line items (Vector fills only).

symbolLines.description: Line items of the fill's repeating symbol pattern (Symbol fills only).

symbolArcs.description: Arc items of the fill's repeating symbol pattern (Symbol fills only).

symbolHotspots.description: Hotspot coordinates of the fill's repeating symbol pattern (Symbol fills only).

frequency.description: The distance between two instances of this item.

direction.description: The angle of the item, measured CCW from the horizontal axis, in radians.

offsetLine.description: The parallel offset of the item, measured from the (rotated) horizontal axis.

lineLengths.description: Dash-gap length pairs describing this line item. Must contain an even number of items.

angle.description: Arc angle in radians, measured CCW.

allStories.description: Whether all stories are shown; if false, firstStory3D to lastStory3D.

filters.description: Optional. Archicad's own flag filters. An element is kept only when it fulfills all of them.

layerIndices.description: Optional. An element is kept only when it is on one of these layers (the layerIndex field of GetDetailsOfElements).

floorIndices.description: Optional. An element is kept only when its home story is one of these (the floorIndex field of GetDetailsOfElements).

elementTypes.description: Optional. An element is kept only when its type is one of these.
