verticalDatum.description: Name by which the vertical datum is identified.

mapProjection.description: Name by which the map projection is identified.

mapZone.description: Name by which the map zone, relating to the MapProjection, is identified.

xAxisAbscissa.description: Value along the easting axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system (IfcMapConversion.XAxisAbscissa).

xAxisOrdinate.description: Value along the northing axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system (IfcMapConversion.XAxisOrdinate).

scale.description: Scale to be used, when the units of the CRS are not identical to the units of the engineering coordinate system (IfcMapConversion.Scale).

isCutPlanes.description: Whether the 3D cut planes are switched on.

useCustom.description: Whether the custom cut settings are used.

cutPlanes.description: The cut planes, in the form accepted by Set3DCutPlanes: pa*x + pb*y + pc*z + pd = 0, pd in meters.

cutawayEnabled.description: Whether 3D Cutaway is on in the 3D window.

cuttingPlanesVisible.description: Whether the cutting planes are shown in the 3D window.

geometries3D.description: The 3D geometry of each element, aligned with the input: the solid bodies of its 3D model, or an error.

counts.description: The number of components of each type in the 3D model Archicad currently holds, one item per type, or an error for a type that could not be counted.

isPersp.description: True for a perspective projection, false for an axonometric one.

cameraElementId.description: The Camera element the projection was set from. Missing when the projection does not come from a camera.

activeCameraSetElementId.description: The active Camera Set element. Missing when there is none.

perspective.description: The perspective parameters. Present only when isPersp is true.

names.description: The names of the 3D styles. An empty name means the current 3D style. When omitted, the current 3D style is returned.

styles.description: The details of the 3D styles, in the order of the input names.

hSize.description: The horizontal size of the 3D window in pixels.

vSize.description: The vertical size of the 3D window in pixels.

zoomScaleX.description: The horizontal zoom scale of the 3D projection.

zoomScaleY.description: The vertical zoom scale of the 3D projection.

zoomDispX.description: The horizontal displacement (pan) of the 3D projection.

zoomDispY.description: The vertical displacement (pan) of the 3D projection.

GetActiveGraphicalOverrideCombinationRes.description: The graphic override combination applied to the current window. Empty when the current window has no combination applied.

name.description: The name of the graphic override combination. Missing when the combination cannot be read, e.g. it was deleted.

version.description: Version number in the form of "1.1.1".

viewpointId.description: The add-on viewpoint root or group to list the children of.

viewpoints.description: The details of each given add-on viewpoint item, in the order of the input, or an error for an item that cannot be read.

classificationSystems.description: The classification systems of the project.

groups.description: The groups to get all the elements of.

elementsOfGroups.description: All the elements of each given group, including the elements of its nested groups, or an error.

elementType.description: Only the Favorites of this element type are returned. Omit it to get every Favorite.

properties.description: Returns only the definitions of these properties. Identifiers not found in the project are left out of the response. All properties are returned when omitted.

propertyTypes.description: Returns only the properties of these types. All types are returned when omitted.

includeAvailability.description: Adds the availability list (the classification items a custom property is available for) to each custom property. Default is true.

propertyGroups.description: Every property group, including empty ones.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model the geometry is read from. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.

links.description: The link and its geometry for each element, in the order of the input. An element that is not an analytical link, or whose link cannot be got, is represented by an error object.

loadGroupId.description: The identifier of the load group to list the load cases of. Every load case of the project is listed when it is omitted.

loadCases.description: The load cases. A load case that cannot be read is represented by an error object.

loadCombinations.description: The load combinations of the project. A load combination that cannot be read is represented by an error object.

loadGroups.description: The load groups of the project. A load group that cannot be read is represented by an error object.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model the geometry is read from. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.

loads.description: The load of each element, in the order of the input, with its geometry in the Structural Analytical Model and, for an edge or a surface load, its custom data (the curve or contour stored with the element). An element that is not an analytical point, edge or surface load, or whose load cannot be got, is represented by an error object.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; before Archicad 27 it is required.

segmentationCentralAngle.description: When given, surface members are read as segmented surface members (for curved walls), each segment spanning at most this central angle, in radians.

analyticalMembers.description: The analytical member of each element, in the order of the input. An element that is no member of the model, or whose member cannot be read, is represented by an error object.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.

memberPartRefs.description: The member parts to get the geometry of: vertices (BegVertex, EndVertex, CustomVertex) give a node, edges (Edge, RatioEdge, CustomEdge) a curve.

geometries.description: The node or curve of each member part, in the order of the input. A member part the geometry cannot be got for, a surface among them, is represented by an error object.

memberTypesOfElements.description: The analytical member type of each element, in the order of the input. An element the type cannot be got for is represented by an error object.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; before Archicad 27 it is required.

curveMembers.description: The elements of the curve members (beams, columns) of the model.

surfaceMembers.description: The elements of the surface members (walls, slabs, roofs) of the model.

modelCheckTypeId.description: The type identifier of the Structural Analytical Model check.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model of the variation.
The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; before Archicad 27 it is required.
The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.

releases.description: The release of each element, in the order of the input. An element the release cannot be got for is represented by an error object.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model the geometry is read from. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.

supports.description: The support and its geometry for each element, in the order of the input. An element that is not an analytical support, or whose support cannot be got, is represented by an error object.

visibilitySettings.description: The Structural Analytical Model visibility settings, with every field.

archicadLocation.description: The location of the Archicad executable in the filesystem.

mainVersion.description: The main version of the running Archicad, e.g. 29.

releaseVersion.description: The release (update) version of the running Archicad.

buildNumber.description: The build number of the running Archicad.

caption.description: The caption of the Archicad application window. Missing when Archicad does not report it.

isVisible.description: True when the Archicad application is shown, false when it is hidden.

projectFilePath.description: The absolute path of the project or template file (for example .pln or .tpl) to read the attributes from.

attributeTypes.description: The attribute types to read. Layer, Surface, BuildingMaterial and MEPSystem cannot be read from a file that is not open; they get an error item.

autoGroup.description: True if the Auto Group mode is currently on.

isOn.description: True if Auto-Intersection is currently on.

elementId.description: Optional. The element to retrieve context dependent autotext keys for (its own properties, plus the ones common to all element types, e.g. 'Element ID', 'Area'). When omitted, only the property based autotext keys common to all element types are returned. The other autotexts (Project Info, layout, drawing, date, ...) are returned either way.

name.description: The autotext's name, as shown in the Insert Autotext dialog of Archicad.

key.description: The autotext's key. To embed it in the content of a Text or Label element, surround it with '<' and '>', e.g. '<PROJECTNAME>' or '<PROPERTY-69A58F6F-DD3B-478D-B5EF-09A16BD0C548>'.

keys.description: Autotext keys as returned by GetAutoTextKeys or GetProjectInfoFields (without the surrounding '<' and '>'), e.g. 'PROPERTY-69A58F6F-DD3B-478D-B5EF-09A16BD0C548' or 'PROJECTNAME'.

filterByTypeId.description: Optional. Filter by libpart type (matches the value returned by LibPartTypeIdToString).

skippedCount.description: Library parts that ACAPI_LibraryPart_Get failed to read. Non-zero means the inventory is partial.

skippedSample.description: First five failed indices with their ACAPI error code, for diagnostic.

bodyMaterials.description: The bodies of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Building Material. If omitted, every field is returned.

buildingMaterials.description: A list of building materials or errors.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for length values.
Number of decimals to display for area values.
Number of decimals to display for volume values.
Number of decimals to display for angle values.

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

categories.description: The categories to read. Left out: every category of the project.

categoryValuesOfDefaults.description: The category values of the tool defaults of each element type, in the order of the input. A category Archicad cannot read for the type is left out of its list; an invalid element type, or one with none of the requested categories, is represented by an error object.

categories.description: The categories to read. Left out: every category the element has.

categoryValuesOfElements.description: The category values of each element, in the order of the input. A category the element does not have is left out of its list; an element that does not exist or has none of the requested categories (an annotation, for example) is represented by an error object.

classificationItemParents.description: The parent and the system of each given item, in the order of the input. A non-existing item is an error item.

targets.description: The elements, element tool defaults and attributes to check the classification items for.

classificationItemVisibilities.description: One entry per target, in the order of the input. A non-existing element or attribute, or an invalid element type, is represented by an error object.

attributeClassifications.description: Order of the items is the same as in the input. classificationItemId is omitted when the attribute is unclassified in the system. Non-existing attributes or a non-existing classification system are represented by error objects.
The classifications of the attributes, in the order of the input. A non-existing attribute is represented by an error object.

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

elementDefaultClassifications.description: Order of the outer list is that of the given element types, the inner list that of the given classification systems. Invalid element types or non-existing classification systems are represented by error objects.

elementClassifications.description: Order of the ids are the same as in the input. Non-existing elements or non-existing classification systems are represented by error objects.

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

classificationsOfToolDefaults.description: The classifications of the tool defaults of each element type, in the order of the given element types. Invalid element types are represented by error objects.

volumeTolerance.description: Intersection body volume greater then this value will be considered as a collision. Default value is 0.001.

performSurfaceCheck.description: Enables surface collision check. If disabled the surfaceTolerance value will be ignored. By default it's false.

surfaceTolerance.description: Intersection body surface area greater then this value will be considered as a collision. Default value is 0.001.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Composite. If omitted, every field is returned.

composites.description: A list of composites or errors.

elements.description: The owner (host) elements whose connected elements are collected, e.g. Walls, Curtain Walls, Stairs or Railings.

connectedElementType.description: The type of the connected elements to collect, e.g. Window or Door for a Wall owner, or a subelement type of a Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing owner.

databases.description: The database of each element, in the order of the input elements. Pass windowType and databaseId to ChangeWindow to open it.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model of the current view.

layerCombinationId.description: The layer combination in effect in the current window. Missing when the current state of the layers matches no layer combination.

name.description: The name of the layer combination. Missing together with layerCombinationId.

index.description: The attribute index of the current Pen Table, as returned by Archicad.

isPenTableAttribute.description: True if the index refers to an existing Pen Table attribute. When false, attributeId and name are omitted; the pens in effect can not be read with GetPenTables.

name.description: The name of the current Pen Table attribute.

penCount.description: The number of pens in the current Pen Table. Omitted when it can not be read.

image.description: The base64 encoded image, in the requested format.

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

scale.description: The denominator of the drawing scale of the current window: 100.0 for 1:100, 20.0 for 1:20. Always 1.0 for layouts.

databaseId.description: The database shown in the current (active) window, the same id GetDatabases and GetContainingDatabases return. Pass it to ChangeWindow to bring this window back. Missing when the window has no database of its own that can be identified, for example a report, a rendering or a custom add-on window. The saved view (View Map item) the window was opened from is not returned: Archicad does not tell which one it was, and several saved views can show the same database.

absoluteBottoms.description: The absolute bottom of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

stretches.description: The custom stretch of the curve member of each element, in the order of the input. An element the stretch cannot be got for is represented by an error object.

cutPolygons.description: The cut of each body of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

types.description: The types of the databases to list. Optional, by default the databases of every type are listed.

descriptorsOfElements.description: The descriptors of each element, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

designOptionSetId.description: The guid identifier of the design option set.

name.description: The name of the design option set.

isEditable.description: Whether the design option set can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork).

notEditableError.description: The reason why the design option set is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

designOptions.description: The list of design options in the set.

teamworkId.description: The Teamwork identifier of the project's design options. Present only in Teamwork projects.

fields.description: Optional filter for the fields to return for each element. When omitted, every field is returned. Fields not listed are not computed at all, so listing only what you need skips in particular the floorPlanPolygons extraction, which regenerates each element's 2D drawing primitives and can dominate the execution time of batch reads.

detailsOfElements.description: One entry per input element, in the same order as the input elements array. An element that cannot be read gets an error entry in its place, so the position of an entry tells which input element it belongs to.

enabled.description: Whether the dialog auto close is on: true while Archicad closes the dialogs it would show with their default button instead of waiting for the user. This is the same state SetDialogAutoClose writes.

elements.description: The identifier of the dimension elements.

name.description: Only the dimension standard with this name is returned (case-sensitive). The list is empty when no standard has this name.
The name of a new 3D Document.

refId.description: The reference ID of a new 3D Document.

materialFrom3D.description: Use the surfaces of the 3D model; when false, cMater is used for every element.

cMater.description: The index of the uniform surface (material), used when materialFrom3D is false.

boundaryPen.description: The pen of the boundary contours, used with OverrideContours.

boundaryLineType.description: The index of the line type of the boundary contours, used with OverrideContours.

contentBoxes.description: One item per input element, in the same order: the full content box of the Drawing, or an error.

lines.description: The lines of the grid of the grid-based drawing numbering of the current layout. Only a layout that uses grid-based drawing numbering has such a grid.

drawingPrimitivesOfElements.description: The drawing primitives of each element, in the order of the input elements.

inEditMode.description: True when Archicad is in any hierarchical editing mode (curtain wall, stair, railing, beam, column, MEP elements, etc.). Only returned from Archicad 29.

elements.description: Optional list of electrical circuits.

electricalPanels.description: Optional list of electrical panels whose circuits are returned. When neither elements nor electricalPanels is given, every circuit of every electrical panel of the project is returned.

electricalCircuits.description: The given circuits first, in their order, then the circuits of the given panels, in the order of the panels.

elements.description: Optional list of electrical devices. Every electrical device of the project is returned when it is not given.

electricalDevices.description: The electrical devices, in the order of the given elements.

elements.description: Optional list of electrical panels. Every electrical panel of the project is returned when it is not given.

electricalPanels.description: The electrical panels, in the order of the given elements.

voltage.description: The default voltage of the project.

elementType.description: The type of the element to look for. Only polygonal element types can be searched, for example Slab, Roof, Mesh, Zone or Hatch.

coordinate.description: The point to search at, in the project's coordinates, on the floor plan of the current database.

z.description: Optional. The elevation of the search point, handed to Archicad together with the coordinate. Default is 0; without z a point 1 mm higher is also tried, so an element whose top is at 0 (for example a slab at the story level) is found.

filters.description: Optional. Only an element passing every given filter is found (the same values as FilterElements accepts).

found.description: True when an element of the given type was found at the coordinate.

elementId.description: The identifier of the found element. Absent when nothing was found.

categories.description: The element categories of the project, each with its possible values.

stateId.description: The state to compare from, as returned by CaptureElementState.

toStateId.description: The state to compare to, as returned by CaptureElementState with the same type as stateId. If omitted, the current state of the project is used, so the response lists what changed since stateId was captured.

newElements.description: The elements that exist in the later state but not in the earlier one.

modifiedElements.description: The elements that exist in both states and changed between them.

deletedElements.description: The elements that exist in the earlier state but not in the later one. They cannot be read any more, only their identifiers are known.

elements.description: The elements to search connections among. Only connections between two of these elements are returned.

connections.description: The connected pairs of the given elements. Each pair appears once.

executionResults.description: Aligned with the input array of elements: whether the element was found and taken into the search.

prompt.description: Shown in the control box while Archicad waits for the click. Single-byte text: the box takes a char field. Archicad's main thread waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then.

elementTypes.description: Only an element of one of these types is accepted. A click on empty space or on an element of another type asks for the click again. Default: any element.

elementId.description: The clicked element. In a section or elevation window it is the model element the section element was cut from.

elementType.description: The type of the clicked element (one of the ElementType values, or Unknown).

position.description: The clicked point in the project's coordinates, as GetPointFromUser returns it.

elementPosition.description: The coordinate of the clicked part of the element (e.g. its node or hotspot), when Archicad gives one for it.

cancelled.description: True when the input was cancelled with Escape; no other field is returned then.

imageType.description: The type of the preview image. Default is 3D.

format.description: The image format. Default is png.

width.description: The width of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

height.description: The height of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

elementSets.description: The element sets to get the data of.
The data of each given element set, or an error.

elementSetsOfElements.description: The element sets that contain each given element, or an error, in the order of the input. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On are examined.

elementTrims.description: One item per queried element, in order. An unknown or deleted element is an error item, so it cannot be mistaken for an element that is simply not trimmed.

elementTypes.description: The element types to get the localized names of.

names.description: The localized name of each element type, aligned with the input, or an error.

keys.description: Optional. Only the pairs with these keys are returned; a key an element does not hold is left out of its pairs. When omitted, every pair stored on each element is returned.

elementUserData.description: One item per element, in the input order: the pairs stored on the element (none when the element holds no user data of Tapir), or an error when the element was not found or its data could not be read.

elementsOfClassificationItems.description: The elements classified with each classification item, aligned with the input, or an error for a non-existing classification item.

ifcIds.description: A list of IFC identifiers to get the corresponding elements for. Each one is either an IFC GlobalId (22 characters) or, before Archicad 28, the 36 character GUID form that GetIFCIdsOfElements returns there as ifcId.

elementType.description: Optional. Only elements of this type are returned, still in drawing order. If omitted, every element is returned.

filters.description: Optional. The filters an element must pass to be returned, the same as for GetElementsByType.

databases.description: The databases to list the elements of, each in its own drawing order. If omitted, the current database is used.

groups.description: The groups to get the elements of.

elementsOfGroups.description: The elements directly contained by each given group, or an error.

arcTolerance.description: The largest distance allowed between an arc and the straight segments that replace it when Archicad segments curves for export, in meters.

favoriteDetails.description: The details of the given favorites, in the order of the input, or an error for a favorite that could not be read.

imageType.description: The type of the preview image. Default is 3D.

format.description: The image format. Default is png.

width.description: The width of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

height.description: The height of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

favoriteSettings.description: The settings of each given Favorite, in the order of the input, or an error for a Favorite that could not be read.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Fill. If omitted, every field is returned. Requesting only the fields you need avoids fetching lineItems/symbolLines/symbolArcs/symbolHotspots, which can be large.

fills.description: A list of fills or errors.

fontNames.description: Names of the fonts to find, as the Text tool's font list shows them and GetDetailsOfElements reports them in fontName, e.g. 'Arial'.

fonts.description: One item per name, in the order given: the font found, or an error when no loaded font has the name.

on.description: Whether the ghost story (Trace & Reference) is shown on the floor plan.

showOne.description: Whether the story at storyIndex is the ghost story.

showAbove.description: Whether the story above the current one is the ghost story.

showBelow.description: Whether the story below the current one is the ghost story.

storyIndex.description: The index of the ghost story, as GetStories reports it. Meaningful when showOne is true.

ghostColor.description: The color the ghost story is drawn in.

filter.description: The element types shown in the ghost story. Types without a Tapir element type name (for example MEP or external ones) are left out, so passing this list to SetGhostStorySettings hides them.

graphicOverrideCombinations.description: The graphic override combinations of the project.

graphicOverrideRuleGroups.description: The graphic override rule groups of the project, empty ones included.

graphicOverrideRules.description: The graphic override rules to get, by name.
The rules, or errors, in the order of the input.
The graphic override rules of the project.

styles.description: The graphic override style of each element in the current window, aligned with the input, or an error.

elementId.description: The grid element. The zero GUID for the tool defaults.

variation.description: Four-character variation of the object: 'GREL' for a grid element.

floorIndex.description: Home story index.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index.

pos.description: Insertion point: the start of the grid line.

angle.description: Direction of the grid line in radians.

length.description: Length of the grid line: the GDL parameter AC_Length of the Grid Tool's grid marker, or the object's A size for a library part without it.

xRatio.description: The object's xRatio as stored: its A size with useXYFixSize on, otherwise the A size divided by the library part's own A.

yRatio.description: The object's yRatio as stored, like xRatio for the B size.

useXYFixSize.description: Whether xRatio and yRatio hold the sizes themselves.

level.description: Elevation of the object from its home story.

libraryPartName.description: Localized name of the library part.

parameters.description: GDL parameters, separators left out. Only when requested.

includeParameters.description: Also return the GDL parameters of each grid element. Default false.

groupGuids.description: The identifier of the group that directly contains each given element, or an error for elements that are not part of any group.

elements.description: The elements whose owners are looked up, e.g. Curtain Wall frames or panels, Stair treads or Railing posts.

owners.description: The owner of each element, aligned with the input.

hotlinkNodes.description: The hotlink nodes, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes.

hotlinkDesignOptionTables.description: One item per requested node, in order: the design options of the hotlinked source file and which of them the node shows, or an error.

hotlinkOwners.description: The hotlink each element comes from, aligned with the input.

hotlinkInstances.description: The placed hotlink instances: elements of type Hotlink, for example the hotlinkId of an element inside one. Not the nodes GetHotlinks returns.

proxyElementTables.description: One item per requested instance, in order: its proxy elements with the source elements they were made from, or an error.

hotlinks.description: The source files of hotlinks of the project, for example the location of each node GetHotlinks returns.

hotlinkSourceStatuses.description: One item per requested hotlink, in order: the availability of its source file, or an error.

hotspotsOfElements.description: The hotspots of the given library part instances, in the order of the input.

storedOnly.description: Return only the attributes stored on the elements, not the ones Archicad would generate on IFC export. Used only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27. Default: false.
Return only the classification references stored on the elements, not the ones Archicad would generate on IFC export. Used only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27. Default: false.

translators.description: The IFC export translators of the project, the preview translator first.

name.description: Issue name

isTagTextElemVisible.description: The visibility of the attached tag text element

keynoteItems.description: The keynote items to get the autotext tokens for.

foldersInRoot.description: The top-level keynote folders with their content recursively. The technical root folder itself is not included.

itemsInRoot.description: The keynote items located directly in the technical root folder.

memberParts.description: The member parts to get the local coordinate system of.

localCoordinateSystems.description: The local coordinate system of each member part, in the order of the input. A member part the coordinate system cannot be got for is represented by an error object.

elementTypes.description: The element types to get the last 3D default level of.

levels.description: The last 3D default level of each element type, in the order of elementTypes, in meters.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Layer. If omitted, every field is returned.

layers.description: A list of layers or errors.

masterLayoutDatabaseId.description: The database of the master layout of the layout. Not present for master layouts.

masterNavigatorItemId.description: The Layout Book navigator item of the master layout of the layout. Not present for master layouts.

masterLayoutName.description: The name of the master layout of the layout. Not present for master layouts.

subsetSettings.description: One item per input navigator item, in the same order: the subset's settings with the field names of CreateLayoutSubset, or an error.

transformations.description: The placement transformation of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

sectionId.description: The type identifier of the custom section. A four-character code is given as its integer value, the first character in the highest byte (e.g. 'ABCD' is 1094861636).

index.description: Optional. The index of the section among the sections with the same identifier. By default 0.

exists.description: Whether the library part has this custom section.

dataVersion.description: The data version stored with the section. Left out when the section does not exist.

data.description: The content of the section, base64 encoded. Left out when the section does not exist.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to look up.

locations.description: The original location of each given library part, in the order of the input.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

previewPicture.description: The preview picture as a base64 encoded PNG. Left out when the library part has none.

darkPreviewPicture.description: The preview picture for the dark user interface as a base64 encoded PNG. Left out when the library part has none, and before Archicad 29.

gdlPictures.description: The pictures stored in the library part for its GDL scripts, as base64 encoded PNGs, in their stored order.

darkGdlPictures.description: The GDL pictures for the dark user interface, as base64 encoded PNGs. Left out before Archicad 29.

startPrompt.description: Prompt for selecting the line start point.
startPrompt.default: Click the start point of the line

endPrompt.description: Prompt for selecting the line end point.
endPrompt.default: Click the end point of the line

showRubberLineFeedback.description: If true, draws a unit-square rubber feedback around the cursor while input is active.

cancelled.description: True if the user cancelled the input (ESC).

startPoint.description: The start point of the line.

endPoint.description: The end point of the line. It is only valid if cancelled is false.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Line. If omitted, every field is returned. Requesting only the fields you need avoids fetching dashItems/lineItems, which can be large.

lines.description: A list of lines or errors.

elements.description: A list of elements, or of element types to read the links of the element defaults of that type.

linkedPropertyObjectsOfElements.description: The property object links of each element or element default, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

elements.description: The elements whose outgoing links are returned.

linksOfElements.description: The links starting from each element, aligned with the input.

objectSetName.description: The name of the lockable object set, as the Archicad API documents it: BuildingMaterials, Cities, Composites, Favorites, FillTypes, LayerSettingsDialog (layers and layer combinations), LineTypes, MarkupStyles, MEPSystems, ModelViewOptions, OperationProfiles, PenTables, Profiles, ProjectInfo, GeoLocation (project location), PreferencesDialog (project preferences and dimension standards), GraphicOverrides (renovation override styles), Surfaces or ZoneCategories. Other names the Archicad API accepts work too.

conflicts.description: The users who hold a reservation on the object set.

distributionSystems.description: The distribution systems of the project.

ports.description: The ports in the distribution systems graph (see GetMEPPorts).

elementDetails.description: The details of the given MEP elements, in the order of the input, or an error for an element that is not an MEP element, and in Archicad 28 for an elbow. A value that cannot be read is left out.

elementTypes.description: Optional filter for the MEP element types.

domains.description: Optional filter for the MEP domains.

elements.description: The MEP elements.

domains.description: The domains whose preference tables to list. Defaults to all three.

items.description: The MEP domain of a preference table container.

containers.description: The preference table container of each domain, in the order of the domains.

tableId.description: The guid of a preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables (the branch, elbow and transition tables with includeFittingTables): a pipe or circular duct segment table, a branch or elbow table of the Piping or Ventilation domain, or, from Archicad 29, a transition table. Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables are found too, but their rows have no key. Archicad 27: any preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers.

keys.description: The keys of the rows to get.

items.description: The key of a row. Segment tables: referenceId. Elbow tables: referenceId and angle. Branch tables: mainAxisReferenceId, branchAxisReferenceId and branchAxisAngle. Transition tables: beginReferenceId and endReferenceId. The angles are as GetMEPPreferenceTables returns them; Archicad 28 finds the rows by their reference ids only and rejects a key with an angle. Archicad 27: shape and index (AddMEPPreferenceTableRows: shape only).

name.description: Archicad 27 only: the name of the table.

sizes.description: Archicad 27 only: the number of rows of each shape.

rows.description: The rows in the order of the keys.

includeFittingTables.description: Also return the elbow, branch and transition preference tables. Defaults to false. Ignored for the CableCarrier domain.

tables.description: The circular segment preference tables of the domain. Empty for the CableCarrier domain.

rectangularTables.description: The rectangular segment preference tables of the Ventilation domain.

cableCarrierTables.description: The segment preference tables of the CableCarrier domain.

referenceSet.description: The reference set of the Piping or Ventilation domain. Not returned for the CableCarrier domain.

elbowTables.description: The elbow preference tables of the domain. Only when includeFittingTables is true.

branchTables.description: The branch preference tables of the domain. Only when includeFittingTables is true.

transitionTables.description: The transition preference tables of the domain. Only when includeFittingTables is true, available from Archicad 29.

elements.description: MEP routing elements, routing nodes or routing segments.

routingParameters.description: The routing parameters of the given elements, in their order.

systemGroups.description: The system groups of the project with their physical systems.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each MEP System. If omitted, every field is returned.

mepSystems.description: A list of MEP systems or errors.

groups.description: The groups to get the top level group of.

mainGroups.description: The top level group of each given group (the group itself if it is not nested in another group), or an error.

markerParametersOfElements.description: The marker of each given element, in the order of the input, or an error for an element that is not a window or a door.

elementMerges.description: One item per queried element, in order: the elements it is merged with. An unknown or deleted element is an error item, so it cannot be mistaken for an element that is simply not merged.

publisherSetName.description: The name of the publisher set to retrieve. Used only when navigatorMapId is PublisherSets. Without it the first publisher set is returned.

includeChildCount.description: Set to true to add childCount, the number of direct children Archicad reports, to every item. Defaults to false.

parentItems.description: The parent of each requested navigator item, in the order of the input, or an error for an item whose parent cannot be read.

autoTextIds.description: Numeric values of the API_NoteAutotextID enumeration of the Archicad API (the autotexts of dimension, label and other element notes).

keywords.description: One result per input id, in the same order.

noteOwnerType.description: The type of the element that owns the note, e.g. 'Dimension', 'RadialDimension', 'LevelDimension' or 'AngleDimension'.

noteAutotexts.description: The autotexts available in the notes of the given owner type, in ascending order of autotextId.

elements.description: The Opening elements (made with the Opening tool) to read.

openings.description: The details of the openings, in the order of the given elements.

elements.description: The Opening elements (made with the Opening tool) to read.

openings.description: The floor plan parameters of the openings, in the order of the given elements.

elements.description: The Opening elements (made with the Opening tool) to read.

openings.description: The GDL parameters of the floor plan symbols of the openings, in the order of the given elements.

openingTransformations.description: The transformation of each given Opening, or an error, in the order of the input elements.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Pen Table. If omitted, every field is returned. Requesting only the fields you need avoids fetching the 255-element pens array.

penTables.description: A list of pen tables or errors.

indices.description: The indices of the pens to return, from 1 to the number of pens (GetCurrentPenTable returns penCount). If omitted, every pen is returned.

pens.description: The pens in effect in the current window, or errors. The order is that of the given indices.

prompt.description: Shown in the control box while Archicad waits for the click. Single-byte text: the box takes a char field. Archicad's main thread waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then.

position.description: The clicked point in the project's coordinates.

startPrompt.description: Prompt for selecting the polygon start point.
startPrompt.default: Click the start point of the polygon

prompt.description: Prompt shown while placing the remaining polygon nodes.
prompt.default: Click polygon nodes and finish the input

cancelled.description: True if the user cancelled the input (ESC).

printer.description: The printer selected in Archicad, or an error when it cannot be read.

plotter.description: The plotter selected in Archicad, or an error when it cannot be read.

fixText.description: Whether text is printed in fixed size.

productName.description: The name of the product. Archicad 29 or later.

productType.description: The Graphisoft product type. Archicad 29 or later.

productFamilyId.description: The identifier of the product family.

languageCode.description: The Graphisoft language code of the running Archicad (for example INT, GER).

buildNumber.description: The build number of the running Archicad.

versionString.description: The full version of the running Archicad as text.

mainVersion.description: The main version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

updateVersion.description: The update version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

hotfixVersion.description: The hotfix version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

versionNumbers.description: The three parts of the version number. Archicad 28 only.

availableDomains.description: The domains available in the running Archicad. Archicad 29 or later.

ceipProjectId.description: The CEIP project identifier of the open project. Left out when no saved project is open. Archicad 29 or later.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Profile. If omitted, every field is returned. Note the raw cross-section vector geometry itself is not exposed; width/height/minimumWidth/minimumHeight/widthStretchable/heightStretchable/hasCoreSkin/profileModifiers are derived measurements matching what the Profile Editor shows, computed from the profile's internal stretch/parameter data.

profiles.description: A list of profiles or errors.

keys.description: The project data stored by Tapir in the project.

names.description: The names of the project data to get.

values.description: The project data in the order of the given names, or an error for a name that has no project data.

isUntitled.description: True, if the project is not saved yet.

isTeamwork.description: True, if the project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project.

projectLocation.description: The location of the project in the filesystem or a BIMcloud project reference.

projectPath.description: The path of the project. A filesystem path or a BIMcloud server relative path.

dateOfIssue.description: Date of issue (free text, as typed in Project Notes).

preferenceTypes.description: The preference pages to get. Every page when missing.

GetProjectPreferencesResult.description: The pages asked for, by name.

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

includeValues.description: Adds the value of each property in the tool default (propertyValue), or an error in its place when it has none. Default is false.

propertiesOfToolDefaults.description: The properties of the tool defaults of each element type, in the order of the given element types. Invalid element types are represented by error objects.

elementType.description: The element type whose current tool default is checked. This is the native tool default, a Favorite counts only after it was applied.

propertyAvailabilities.description: The order is that of the given properties.

propertyDefinitionsOfAttributes.description: The property definitions of each attribute, in the order of the given attributes.

propertyObjectsOfElements.description: The property objects of each element, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

includeStatus.description: If true, each item also tells whether the property is available, editable and visible for the attribute, and a property without an available value is returned with its status and without a value instead of as an error. The default is false.

propertyValuesForAttributes.description: The order of the outer list is that of the given attributes. The order of the inner lists are that of the given properties.

includeAvailability.description: Adds isAvailable to each property value or error, telling whether the property is available for the element (for example by its classification). Default is false.

useSIUnits.description: Returns precise, locale-independent numeric strings in SI units, except degrees for angles. Default is false.

propertyValuesForElements.description: The order of the outer list is that of the given elements. The order of the inner lists are that of the given properties.

minOpeningSize.description: Optional minimum opening size in square meters. Openings smaller than this are not subtracted when the conditional values (for example volumeConditional of a Wall) are calculated. Archicad only uses it for walls. Default value is 0, so every opening is subtracted.

calculateInOneCall.description: Optional. When true, Archicad calculates the quantities of all the supported elements in one call instead of one call per element, which can be faster for many elements. The output has the same format. If that one call fails, every supported element gets the same error. Default value is false.

quantitiesOfElements.description: The quantities of the elements, in the order of the given elements. Lengths are in meters, areas in square meters and volumes in cubic meters.

otherElementType.description: Optional filter: only relations to elements of this type are returned.

relations.description: Type-specific relations of each element, aligned with the input.

sceneNames.description: The names of the rendering scenes of the project, in the order of the Scene list of the PhotoRendering Settings palette. The API does not tell which one is current.

renovationFilters.description: Every renovation filter of the project.

activeRenovationFilterId.description: Identifier of the renovation filter of the current window. Absent when the current window has none or it could not be read.

renovationStatuses.description: The renovation statuses an element can have, in the order Existing, New, Demolished.

reservationStatuses.description: One item per input element, in the same order.

customScheme.description: The custom scheme fields of the revision issues (key and name). Present only when the project defines any.

format.description: The image format. Default is png.

width.description: The width of the preview image in pixels. Default is 256.

height.description: The height of the preview image in pixels. Default is 256.

offset.description: Offset of the clip polygon from the edge of the zone. Default is 0.001.

scale.description: Scale of the view (e.g. 0.005 for 1:200). Default is 0.005.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the generated image. Default is white (1.0, 1.0, 1.0).

hasResult.description: True if the Script UI page has submitted a result since the last call.

result.description: The submitted content (as passed to window.ACAPI.SubmitResult). Only present when hasResult is true.

isOpen.description: True while the Script UI palette is open. False before the first ShowScriptUI call and once the user closed the palette with its close box, the page called window.ACAPI.ClosePalette or Archicad closed it; stays true while Archicad only temporarily hides all palettes (e.g. during a modal dialog). Lets a waiting script stop polling when the user closes the palette.

databases.description: The section, elevation or interior elevation databases to list the section elements of. If omitted, the current database is used.

sectionElements.description: The elements drawn in the given databases, each with the owner element it was generated from.

sectionElementId.description: The identifier of the section element itself, accepted by CreateAssociativeDimensionsOnSection as sectionElementId.

ownerElementId.description: The identifier of the owner element the section element was generated from - this is what every other listing command returns.

ownerElementType.description: The type of the owner element. Only present when the owner's header is readable from the section database.

skylightHolePolygons.description: The hole each Skylight cuts into its host Roof or Shell, aligned with the input: its polygon, or an error (for example for an element that is not a Skylight).

elements.description: Elements to query. Returns all solid links where each element is a target or an operator.

solidLinks.description: For each input element, the solid links where it acts as target and where it acts as operator.

folderTypes.description: The types of the special folders to retrieve.

skipNullFloor.description: Floor indices above ground-floor level may start with 1 instead of 0.

databaseId.description: A section, elevation or interior elevation database, for example as GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId returns it.

primitives.description: The primitives of the story levels drawn in the database, in the order Archicad draws them. The Ctrl_* items mark the beginning and the end of sub-parts (texts, ...).

GetStructureDisplayResult.description: The Partial Structure Display of the current window.

is3D.description: True when the setting belongs to the 3D window.

externalSubelements.description: The subelements of an external hierarchical element (for example an MEP element or an element of another add-on). Available from Archicad 28.

timeZoneInMinutes.description: The time zone of the project location in minutes, as Archicad stores it.

timeZoneOffset.description: The time zone offset of the project location in minutes, as Archicad stores it.

sunPosition.description: The sun position for the project's date, time and location.

elements.description: The elements to get the surface quantities of.

coverElements.description: Optional covering elements: the area where one of them overlaps a surface of an element is subtracted from that surface, so for example a slab on a wall takes its footprint off the top surface of the wall. When omitted, every Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Morph, Mesh, Stair and Curtain Wall of the project is a covering element. Pass an empty array to get the whole surfaces with nothing subtracted. An element never covers itself.

surfaceQuantitiesOfElements.description: The surface quantities of the elements, in the order of the given elements. Areas are in square meters.

surfaceTypes.description: The polygons of the 3D model of each element with their surface types, aligned with the input, or an error.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Surface. If omitted, every field is returned.

surfaces.description: A list of surfaces or errors.

projectToSurvey.description: The 3x4 matrix that transforms a point given in the Project Origin coordinate system into the Survey Point coordinate system, row by row (12 numbers): x' = m[0]*x + m[1]*y + m[2]*z + m[3], y' = m[4]*x + m[5]*y + m[6]*z + m[7], z' = m[8]*x + m[9]*y + m[10]*z + m[11].

surveyToProject.description: The inverse of projectToSurvey in the same row by row layout: it transforms a point given in the Survey Point coordinate system into the Project Origin coordinate system. Missing when projectToSurvey is not invertible.

suspendGroups.description: True if the Suspend Groups mode is currently on.

owners.description: The Teamwork owner of each given database, in the order of the input. userId is 0 when nobody owns the database.

isTeamwork.description: True, if the opened project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project. When false, every other Teamwork field is left out.

isOnline.description: True, if the Teamwork project is connected to its BIMcloud server. False in a solo project or when the Teamwork project works offline.

userId.description: The Teamwork user identifier of the current user, as the Teamwork commands report users.

userName.description: The name of the current Teamwork user.

serverUrl.description: The address of the BIMcloud server of the Teamwork project.

projectName.description: The name of the Teamwork project on the server.

isShared.description: Whether the opened project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project.

isOnline.description: Whether there is a live connection to the Teamwork server. Always false for a project that is not shared.

users.description: The members of the shared project. Only present when the project is shared.

hotlinkCacheManagementOwner.description: The user who has reserved the Hotlink and XRef management. Only present when somebody has reserved it.

textureCoordinates.description: The texture coordinates of each element, aligned with the input: per solid body of its 3D model, or an error.

urlReferences.description: The web link of each given element, or an error. An element without a link gets the error APIERR_NOUSERDATA.

GetUsedAttributesResult.description: The attributes in use, as Archicad reports them for the usedAttributes JSON query. The Archicad API does not document the layout of the report, so it is passed on as it comes: parsed into usedAttributes when it is a JSON object, otherwise as text in raw.

usedAttributes.description: The report parsed as a JSON object.

raw.description: The report as text, when it is not a JSON object.

userDataOfAttributes.description: One item per attribute, in the input order: the pairs stored on the attribute (none when it holds no user data), or an error when the attribute was not found or holds user data in another layout.

groups.description: The groups to get the user data of.

userDataOfGroups.description: The user data attached to each given group, or an error for groups that have none.

userId.description: The stable GSID User ID of the logged-in user.

organizationIds.description: The list of organization IDs the user belongs to. Empty if not part of any organization or if the information cannot be retrieved.

modelViewOptionIndex.description: The index of the model view option combination the window applies. Matches the order of GetModelViewOptions, starting from 1.

structureDisplay.description: The Partial Structure Display mode to check the elements in. The current window is not changed.

visibleSkinStatuses.description: Whether each element has a visible skin in the given Partial Structure Display mode, aligned with the input, or an error.

zoneElementId.description: The identifier of a single Zone. Prefer the zones array: querying many Zones in one call is much faster than one call per Zone.

zones.description: A list of Zones. Only one of zoneElementId and zones can be given.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Zone Category. If omitted, every field is returned.

zoneCategories.description: A list of zone categories or errors.

isAutomaticLabelingOn.description: Whether the automatic labeling of Zones (placing a Label on each new Zone) is on.

selectedFavoriteName.description: The name of the Label Favorite that is placed on each new Zone. Missing when no Favorite is selected.

elements.description: A list of Zones.

reductionsOfZones.description: The area reductions of each Zone, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

userId.description: The Teamwork user id of the user to hand the elements over to, as GetTeamworkProjectInfo, GetReservationStatusOfElements and the conflicts of ReserveElements report users.

names.description: The names of the project data, reserved by the current user, to grant.

toUserId.description: The Teamwork user id of the user who gets the project data, for example the userId of a user returned by GetProjectDataKeys or ReserveProjectData.

GraphicOverrideColumnCoatingType.description: Matches columns whose coating type equals this.

GraphicOverrideColumnCrossSectionType.description: Matches columns whose cross section type equals this.

name.description: The name of the combination, unique within the project.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The rules of the combination, in priority order.
The rules of the combination, in priority order.

GraphicOverrideCombinationId.description: The identifier of a graphic override combination.

GraphicOverrideCombinationIdOrError.description: A graphic override combination identifier or an error.

name.description: The new name of the combination, unique within the project. The current name is kept when omitted.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The new rules of the combination, in priority order. They replace the current rules. The current rules are kept when omitted.

GraphicOverrideCriterion.description: Structured conditions of a graphic override rule, turned into Archicad's criterion XML (an alternative to criterionXML). Give exactly one property. 'and'/'or' combine a flat list of other conditions (no nesting, see their description). 'elementType' filters by the tool an element was created with; 'all3DTypes'/'all2DTypes' match every 3D or 2D element. The other properties are conditions of Archicad's criteria editor: classification, layer and Model View, Construction, Positioning, Plan and Section, Surfaces and Materials, ID and Categories, Geometry, custom properties, and fields of the Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Object/Lamp, Door/Window, Opening, Curtain Wall and Stair tools. Their identifiers were captured from rules made in the criteria editor of Archicad 29; Archicad 27 keeps the generated rules as well. Not available: the renovation status of an element, and the shape, limits and orientation of an Opening.

and.description: Matches if all of the nested criteria match. The nested criteria must all be leaves (elementType, classification, layer*, ...) - an 'and'/'or' nested inside this array is rejected, ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not reliably support that depth of nesting.

or.description: Matches if any of the nested criteria match. The nested criteria must all be leaves (elementType, classification, layer*, ...) - an 'and'/'or' nested inside this array is rejected, ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not reliably support that depth of nesting.

elementType.description: Matches elements created with this tool.

classification.description: Matches elements classified with this Classification System item ID (e.g. 'Slab'), or with any descendant of it in the classification tree (ArchiCAD's 'is in the branch of' operator - not a strict equality check).

classificationNot.description: Matches elements NOT classified with this Classification System item ID and not with any descendant of it in the classification tree (ArchiCAD's 'is not in the branch of' operator - not a strict inequality check).

classificationSystem.description: The classification system 'classification'/'classificationNot' refers to: its name as shown in the Classification Manager (e.g. 'Classification Archicad'), or its name and version as the criteria editor shows them (e.g. 'Classification Archicad - v 2.0'). Left out: the only classification system of the project that contains the item ID; an error when several do.

all3DTypes.description: If true, matches every 3D model element type.

all2DTypes.description: If true, matches every 2D drawing element type.

missingAttributes.description: Matches elements whose 'Missing attributes' status equals this value.

missingLibraryPart.description: Matches elements whose 'Missing library part' status equals this value (e.g. an Object/Lamp referencing a library part not found in the loaded libraries).

layer.description: Matches elements on this layer (by layer name).

layerNot.description: Matches elements NOT on this layer (by layer name).

layerLocked.description: Matches elements whose layer's locked state equals this value.

layerVisible.description: Matches elements whose layer's visible state equals this value.

layerCombination.description: Matches elements whose layer is shown in this layer combination (by layer combination name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.

layerCombinationNot.description: Matches elements whose layer is NOT shown in this layer combination (by layer combination name).

layerNameIs.description: Matches elements whose layer name equals this string exactly.

layerNameIsNot.description: Matches elements whose layer name does not equal this string.

layerNameContains.description: Matches elements whose layer name contains this substring.

layerNameNotContains.description: Matches elements whose layer name does not contain this substring.

layerNameStartsWith.description: Matches elements whose layer name starts with this substring.

layerNameEndsWith.description: Matches elements whose layer name ends with this substring.

compositeStructure.description: Matches elements built with this Composite Structure attribute (by name).

compositeStructureNot.description: Matches elements NOT built with this Composite Structure attribute (by name).

complexProfile.description: Matches elements built with this Complex Profile attribute (by name).

complexProfileNot.description: Matches elements NOT built with this Complex Profile attribute (by name).

compositeStructureNameIs.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name equals this string exactly.

compositeStructureNameIsNot.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name does not equal this string.

compositeStructureNameContains.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name contains this substring.

compositeStructureNameNotContains.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name does not contain this substring.

compositeStructureNameStartsWith.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name starts with this substring.

compositeStructureNameEndsWith.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name ends with this substring.

complexProfileNameIs.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name equals this string exactly.

complexProfileNameIsNot.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name does not equal this string.

complexProfileNameContains.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name contains this substring.

complexProfileNameNotContains.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name does not contain this substring.

complexProfileNameStartsWith.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name starts with this substring.

complexProfileNameEndsWith.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name ends with this substring.

roofConnected.description: Matches roofs whose 'connected to other roof(s)' status equals this value.

seaLevelAltitude.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude equals this value.

seaLevelAltitudeNot.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude does not equal this value.

seaLevelAltitudeLessThan.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude is less than this value.

seaLevelAltitudeGreaterThan.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude is greater than this value.

seaLevelAltitudeLessOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude is less than or equal to this value.

seaLevelAltitudeGreaterOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude is greater than or equal to this value.

projectZeroAltitude.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero equals this value.

projectZeroAltitudeNot.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero does not equal this value.

projectZeroAltitudeLessThan.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is less than this value.

projectZeroAltitudeGreaterThan.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is greater than this value.

projectZeroAltitudeLessOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is less than or equal to this value.

projectZeroAltitudeGreaterOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is greater than or equal to this value.

groundFloorAltitude.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor equals this value.

groundFloorAltitudeNot.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor does not equal this value.

groundFloorAltitudeLessThan.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is less than this value.

groundFloorAltitudeGreaterThan.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is greater than this value.

groundFloorAltitudeLessOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is less than or equal to this value.

groundFloorAltitudeGreaterOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is greater than or equal to this value.

roofAltitude.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude equals this value.

roofAltitudeNot.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude does not equal this value.

roofAltitudeLessThan.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude is less than this value.

roofAltitudeGreaterThan.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude is greater than this value.

roofAltitudeLessOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude is less than or equal to this value.

roofAltitudeGreaterOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude is greater than or equal to this value.

floorIndex.description: Matches elements whose placement story equals this 0-based story/floor index (same convention as floorIndex elsewhere in Tapir). Only equality is supported - ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not offer a 'not equal' option for this field.

sillHeight.description: Matches Door/Window/RoofWindow/Opening elements whose sill height equals this value.

lintelHeight.description: Matches Door/Window/RoofWindow/Opening elements whose lintel height equals this value.

screedThickness.description: Matches Door/Window/RoofWindow elements whose screed thickness ('Epaisseur chape') equals this value.

linkedUpperStoryAbsolute.description: Matches Stair/Zone elements whose absolute linked upper story equals this 0-based story index. Only equality is supported. -31001 means 'not linked' ('Non lie').

linkedUpperStoryRelative.description: Matches Stair/Zone elements whose relative linked upper story equals this value. Only equality is supported. -31001 means 'not linked' ('Non lie').

mepDiameter.description: Matches MEP elements whose diameter equals this value.

mepDiameter2.description: Matches MEP elements whose 2nd diameter equals this value.

mepDN.description: Matches MEP elements whose nominal diameter (DN) equals this value.

GraphicOverrideCustomPropertyBool.description: Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) boolean property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under (both exactly as shown in the Property Manager). Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one of the operators below. The 6 'has.../is...' operators are available on every custom property type, not just boolean ones.

name.description: The custom property's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined (e.g. 'Generalites').

equals.description: Matches if the property's value equals this.

hasDefaultValue.description: If true, matches elements where this property currently has its default value.

hasCustomValue.description: If true, matches elements where this property has a custom (overridden, non-default) value.

isAvailable.description: If true, matches elements where this property is available.

isNotAvailable.description: If true, matches elements where this property is not available.

isUndefined.description: If true, matches elements where this property is undefined.

isNotUndefined.description: If true, matches elements where this property is not undefined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.

GraphicOverrideCustomPropertyString.description: Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) text or option-set property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.

name.description: The custom property's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.

equals.description: Matches if the property's value equals this string exactly.

notEquals.description: Matches if the property's value does not equal this string.

GraphicOverrideRule.description: A graphic override rule with its rule group, criterion and style.

ruleGroupName.description: The name of the rule group the rule belongs to.

criterionXML.description: The criterion of the rule, in the XML format Archicad saves override rules in. Change its values and pass it to CreateGraphicOverrideRules or ModifyGraphicOverrideRules to make similar rules.

name.description: The name of the rule, unique within the project.

ruleGroupName.description: The name of the rule group to put the rule in. Created when it does not exist.

criterionXML.description: The criterion of the rule, in the XML format Archicad saves override rules in. Take it from GetGraphicOverrideRules and change its values: Archicad drops XML written from scratch without an error, and the rule then applies to all elements. Left out together with 'criterion': Archicad's default criterion for new rules.

criterion.description: The criterion of the rule as structured conditions, turned into Archicad's criterion XML. Use it instead of criterionXML, not with it.

name.description: The current name of the rule group.

newName.description: The new name of the rule group. It must not be empty or used by another rule group.

GraphicOverrideRuleId.description: The identifier of a graphic override rule.

GraphicOverrideRuleIdOrError.description: A graphic override rule identifier or an error.

name.description: The new name of the rule.

criterionXML.description: The new criterion of the rule, in the XML format Archicad saves override rules in. Take it from GetGraphicOverrideRules and change its values: Archicad drops XML written from scratch without an error, and the rule then applies to all elements.

criterion.description: The new criterion of the rule as structured conditions, turned into Archicad's criterion XML. Use it instead of criterionXML, not with it.

ruleGroupName.description: The rule group the rule is moved to; it can be the rule's own group to change its place there. Created when no rule group has this name.

beforeGraphicOverrideRuleId.description: The rule of the target group the moved rule is put in front of. Left out: the rule becomes the last of the group.

GraphicOverrideRuleOrError.description: A graphic override rule or an error.

name.description: The name of the rule group.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The rules of the group in their new order. Each must be a rule of this group, listed once. The listed rules come first, in this order; the rules of the group that are not listed keep their order after them.

name.description: The name of the rule. Rule names are unique within the project.

ruleGroupName.description: The name of the rule group to search the rule in. Left out: every rule group is searched.

GraphicOverrideStyle.description: What a graphic override rule overrides and how. A field that is left out is not overridden.

overridePenColorAndThickness.description: Override the pen color and thickness.

hiddenContours.description: The contours to hide when overrideContours is true.

GraphicOverrideSurfaceTypes.description: The surface types an override applies to.

ruleGroupName.description: Name of the rule group the rule belongs to.

criterionXML.description: The criterion in Archicad's own XML format. Change its values and pass it to CreateGraphicalOverrideRule to make similar rules.
