floorIndex.description: Home story index. Default: the tool default.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index. Only a positive index takes effect. Default: the tool default.

parameters.description: GDL parameters to set by name (read the names with GetGridElementDefaults). The value is a number, a boolean or a string. Unknown names and wrong value types are reported in warnings and skipped. The tool defaults can look different from a grid drawn with the Grid Tool (for example a short line with a leader to the bubble); to get the same look, copy the parameters of such a grid (GetGridElements with includeParameters).

elementId.description: The grid element. The zero GUID for the tool defaults.

variation.description: Four-character variation of the object: 'GREL' for a grid element.

floorIndex.description: Home story index.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index.

pos.description: Insertion point: the start of the grid line.

angle.description: Direction of the grid line in radians.

length.description: Length of the grid line: the GDL parameter AC_Length of the Grid Tool's grid marker, or the object's A size for a library part without it.

xRatio.description: The object's xRatio as stored: its A size with useXYFixSize on, otherwise the A size divided by the library part's own A.

yRatio.description: The object's yRatio as stored, like xRatio for the B size.

useXYFixSize.description: Whether xRatio and yRatio hold the sizes themselves.

level.description: Elevation of the object from its home story.

libraryPartName.description: Localized name of the library part.

parameters.description: GDL parameters, separators left out. Only when requested.

GridElementLengthMode.description: How the line length is applied. length (default): to the GDL parameter AC_Length when the library part has it, as the Grid Tool's grid marker does; otherwise to the object's A size, converted to xRatio as CreateObjects does. none: the length is left to 'parameters'.

value.description: A number or a boolean for a numeric parameter, a string for a String or Title parameter.

type.description: Integer, Length, Angle, RealNum, LightSwitch, ColorRGB, Intensity, LineType, Material, FillPattern, PenColor, String, Boolean, Title, BuildingMaterial, Profile, Dictionary or Unknown.

value.description: Number for numeric and boolean types, string for String and Title. Not given for arrays.

dimension1.description: First dimension of an array parameter.

dimension2.description: Second dimension of an array parameter.

GridSettingsUpdate.description: The grid settings to change, in the form GetGridSettings returns. Only the given keys are changed; a color may give only some of its components.

spaceMainX.description: The horizontal spacing of the main grid, in meters.

spaceMainY.description: The vertical spacing of the main grid, in meters.

nLineMainX.description: The number of main horizontal grid lines.

nLineMainY.description: The number of main vertical grid lines.

spaceAuxX.description: The horizontal spacing of the auxiliary grid, in meters.

spaceAuxY.description: The vertical spacing of the auxiliary grid, in meters.

nLineAuxX.description: The number of horizontal auxiliary grid lines.

nLineAuxY.description: The number of vertical auxiliary grid lines.

snapOffsX.description: The horizontal offset of the snap grid, in meters.

snapOffsY.description: The vertical offset of the snap grid, in meters.

snapStepX.description: The horizontal spacing of the snap grid, in meters.

snapStepY.description: The vertical spacing of the snap grid, in meters.

status.description: The status of the grid, as Archicad stores it.

gridAngle.description: The rotation angle of the grid.

gridOffsX.description: The X offset of the grid.

gridOffsY.description: The Y offset of the grid.

gridOffsZ.description: The Z offset of the grid.

gridColor.description: A color with transparency, each component from 0 to 1.

GroupIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the group identifier.

GroupUserData.description: The user data an add-on attached to the group.

dataVersion.description: The version of the user data, as set by the add-on that attached it.

platformSign.description: The platform sign of the user data, which tells the byte order the data was written in.

flags.description: The flags of the user data (APIUserDataFlag_FillWith and APIUserDataFlag_Pickup bits), as set by the add-on that attached it.

data.description: The bytes of the user data, base64 encoded. Empty when the user data has no bytes.

pairs.description: The key-value pairs of the user data, decoded from data. Only present when dataVersion is 1, the layout SetUserDataOfGroups writes.

Guid.description: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

HatchData.description: The parameters of the new Hatch.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

floorInd.description: The identifier of the floor. Optional parameter, by default the current floor is used.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the hatch on. Optional parameter, by default the current layer is used.

coordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the hatch outline. Do not repeat the first point at the end.

arcs.description: The arcs of the hatch outline.

holes.description: Optional holes of the hatch, each with its polygonOutline and optional polygonArcs (arc indices are relative to the hole's own outline). The same format SetDetailsOfElements accepts and GetDetailsOfElements returns for hatches.

contourPenIndex.description: Optional pen index for the contour. By default the current pen is used.

fillPenIndex.description: Optional pen index for the fill. By default the current pen is used.

foregroundColor.description: Optional RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill foreground, used instead of fillPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillPenIndex when both are given. The same format as the colors returned by GetZoneCategories and GetPenTables.

backgroundColor.description: Optional RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill background, used instead of fillBackgroundPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillBackgroundPenIndex when both are given.

fillId.description: Optional fill attribute. By default the current fill is used.

roomSpecial.description: Special area percent in a room (negative means OFF).

arcs.description: The arcs of the hatch outline.

foregroundColor.description: RGB color of the fill foreground. Only present when it overrides fillPenIndex.

backgroundColor.description: RGB color of the fill background. Only present when it overrides fillBackgroundPenIndex.

fillId.description: The fill attribute used, if the hatch's type is a plain fill hatch.

buildingMaterialId.description: The building material attribute used, if the hatch's type is a building material hatch.

roomSpecial.description: Special area percent in a room (negative means OFF).

showArea.description: True if the area text is shown.

HatchOrientation.description: Orientation and distortion parameters of a fill. When modifying an element, omitted properties keep their current values.

origin.description: The origin of the fill relative to the project origin.

matrix00.description: X component of the primary distortion (direction) vector.

matrix10.description: Y component of the primary distortion (direction) vector.

matrix01.description: X component of the secondary distortion vector.

matrix11.description: Y component of the secondary distortion vector.

innerRadius.description: Radius for circular fill distortion, used when type is Centered.

HatchSettings.description: Settings for modifying a Hatch. Setting coordinates replaces the entire polygon (outline plus optional holes) and may change the number of vertices.

fillPenIndex.description: Setting a pen removes the foregroundColor override, so the pen shows.

fillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Setting a pen removes the backgroundColor override, so the pen shows.

foregroundColor.description: RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill foreground, used instead of fillPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillPenIndex when both are given.

backgroundColor.description: RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill background, used instead of fillBackgroundPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillBackgroundPenIndex when both are given.

ownerElementId.description: The owner element. For a main element (e.g. a Curtain Wall) or an element that is not part of a hierarchical element, Archicad returns the input element itself.

hierarchicalElementType.description: The classification of the input element (not of its owner): MainElement is the main element of a hierarchical element (e.g. a Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing), ChildElement is a subelement of one (e.g. a frame or a tread), SingleElement is not part of a hierarchical element.

HierarchicalOwnerMode.description: root (default): the root of the hierarchical element tree, e.g. the Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing. parent: the immediate parent, which may itself be a subelement.

highlightedColors.description: A list of colors to highlight elements.

items.description: Color of the highlighted element as an [r, g, b, a] array. Each component must be in the 0-255 range.

wireframe3D.description: Optional parameter. Switch non highlighted elements in the 3D window to wireframe.

nonHighlightedColor.description: Optional parameter. Color of the non highlighted elements as an [r, g, b, a] array. Each component must be in the 0-255 range. Ignored on Archicad 25.

Hole2DWithLegacyCoordinates.description: A 2D hole in an element defined by closed polylines. The outline is given in 'polygonOutline'; 'polygonCoordinates' is accepted as a legacy alias.

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the edge of the hole.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the hole.

Hole2DWithOutline.description: A 2D hole in an element defined by closed polylines. The outline is given in 'polygonOutline'; 'polygonCoordinates' is accepted as a legacy alias.

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the edge of the hole.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the hole.

Hole3D.description: A 3D hole in an element defined by closed polylines

polygonCoordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the polygon of the hole.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the hole.

Holes2D.description: A list of 2D holes in an element defined by closed polylines

Holes3D.description: A list of 3D holes in an element defined by closed polylines

Hotlink.description: The details of a hotlink node.

location.description: The path of the hotlink file.

name.description: The display name of the hotlink node.

instances.description: The hotlink instance elements placed from the node, in the order Archicad returns them - the input of ChangeHotlinkInstances and DeleteElements. Omitted when the node's instances cannot be read.

children.description: The children of the hotlink node if it has any.

HotlinkDesignOptionFilterMode.description: What the node shows: only the main model of the source, the active option of each set, or the active combination.

name.description: The name of the set.

options.description: The names of the design options in the set.

activeOption.description: The name of the option the node shows from this set. Left out when none is active.

nodeGuid.description: The node guid the design option table belongs to.

sets.description: The design option sets of the source file.

combinations.description: The names of the design option combinations of the source file.

activeCombination.description: The name of the combination the node shows. Left out when none is active.

HotlinkDetails.description: Details of a placed hotlink instance: which node it comes from and where it sits.

rotationAngle.description: Counter-clockwise rotation about the origin, in radians.

mirrored.description: True when the module's local X axis is reflected.

origin.description: If z is omitted, the instance's current z is kept.

rotationAngle.description: Rotation about the origin, counter-clockwise, in radians.

mirrored.description: Reflect the module's local X axis before the rotation.

layerIndex.description: Move the instance to this layer.

hotlinkNodeId.description: The node to place, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes. On Archicad 25 a node that has never been placed cannot be read, so a node created through the API can only be placed from Archicad 26 on.

origin.description: If z is omitted, the instance is placed at 0.

rotationAngle.description: Optional rotation about the origin, counter-clockwise, in radians. Defaults to 0.

mirrored.description: Optional. Reflects the module's local X axis before the rotation. Defaults to false.

floorIndex.description: Optional story the instance is placed on. Defaults to the current story.

floorDifference.description: Optional story offset applied to the module's stories. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

layerIndex.description: Optional layer of the instance. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default layer.

skipNested.description: Optional. Do not place hotlinks nested inside the module. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

suspendFixAngle.description: Optional. Rotate fixed-angle elements with the module. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

ignoreTopFloorLinks.description: Optional. Top-linked elements keep their height rather than their top story link. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

relinkWallOpenings.description: Optional. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

adjustLevelDiffs.description: Optional. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

sourceLocation.description: Absolute path of the new module source file (.mod or .pln).

existing.description: True when a node for the same source file already existed and was returned instead of created.

HotlinkNodeCreatedOrError.description: The created (or already existing) node's guid, or an error.

HotlinkNodeId.description: The identifier of a hotlink node - the reference to a module source file, which instances are placed from.

HotlinkOrigin.description: Where a hotlink instance's origin lands, in the project's coordinates.

HotlinkOwnersOfElement.description: The hotlink an element comes from. Both ids are omitted when the element is not part of a hotlinked module.

isInHotlink.description: True when Archicad reports a hotlink for the element, that is, when at least one of the ids below is returned.

hotlinkElementId.description: The hotlink element which contains the element (ACAPI_Hotlink_GetContainingHotlinkGuid).

hotlinkInstanceId.description: The hotlink instance the element belongs to (ACAPI_Hotlink_GetHotLinkOwner).

HotlinkOwnersOfElementOrError.description: The hotlink an element comes from, or an error.

proxyElementId.description: The proxy element in the current project.

sourceElementId.description: The element in the hotlink's source file the proxy was made from.

proxyElements.description: The proxy elements of the instance, in no particular order.

location.description: Absolute path of the hotlink's source file.

HotlinkSourceStatus.description: The API_HotlinkSourceStatus value without its prefix (AuthCanceld is spelled as in the API).

HotspotData.description: The parameters of the new Hotspot.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

floorInd.description: The identifier of the floor. Optional parameter, by default the current floor is used.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the hotspot on. Optional parameter, by default the current layer is used.

penIndex.description: Optional pen index. By default the current pen is used.

height.description: Z coordinate of the hotspot (can come from a GDL script).

IFCClassificationReferenceSource.description: Where the reference comes from: preview (mapped by the preview IFC export translator) or local (stored on the element). Missing in Archicad 25, 26 and 27, where the storedOnly input chooses between the stored references and all of them.

IFCClassificationSource.description: The classification (IfcClassification) the reference belongs to.

name.description: The name of the classification.

source.description: The source of the classification. Missing when it has no value.

edition.description: The edition of the classification. Missing when it has no value.

editionDate.description: The edition date of the classification. Given only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27, missing when it has no value.

description.description: The description of the classification. Given only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27, missing when it has no value.

location.description: The location of the classification, for example a URL. Given only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27, missing when it has no value.

IFCClassificationSourceData.description: The classification (IfcClassification) the reference belongs to.

name.description: The name of the classification.

edition.description: The edition of the classification. Default: empty.

editionDate.description: The edition date of the classification. Default: empty.

description.description: The description of the classification. Default: empty.

location.description: The location of the classification, for example a URL. Default: empty.

IFCClassificationSourceReference.description: The classification (IfcClassification) the reference belongs to.

name.description: The name of the classification.
The name of the translator, as the IFC Translators dialog shows it.

preview.description: Whether this is the preview translator, the one the IFC properties of elements are previewed with.

method.description: The file operation method to use.

ifcFilePath.description: The target IFC file to use.

fileType.description: The type of the IFC file. The default is 'ifc'.

translatorName.description: Only for the save method: the name of the IFC export translator to save with, as GetIFCExportTranslators lists them. Without it the save runs with the translator Archicad would offer in its own Save dialog. Needs a fileType of ifc or ifczip (ifc or ifcxml on Archicad 25 and 26).

elementsToExport.description: Only for the save method, and only together with translatorName. The default is VisibleElementsOnAllStories.

IFCPropertySource.description: Where the property comes from: preview for the properties mapped by the preview IFC export translator, local for the IFC properties stored in the element. Available from Archicad 28.

IFCPropertyType.description: The kind of the IFC property.

ImageColorDepth.description: Optional, trueColor by default. The color depth of the image, as in the Save as picture dialog.

ImageFormat.description: Optional. The image file format; omitted, it comes from the extension of imageFilePath (.png, .jpg or .jpeg, .bmp, .tif or .tiff, .gif).

xml.description: A Classification Manager export (XML) to import.

path.description: Absolute path on the AC host. With the prefs format: a Favorites file (.prefs) or folder. With the xml format: the folder of Favorite files, as ExportFavorites writes it. With the legacyPRF format: the .prf file.

fileNames.description: Only with the xml format: the names of the Favorite files in the folder to import. Default: every Favorite file of the folder.

targetFolder.description: Folder hierarchy under which to import. Empty = root. With the xml and legacyPRF formats the folder must exist, and omitting it keeps the folders stored with the Favorites.

importFolders.description: Only with the prefs format: if true and `path` is a folder, the folder structure is preserved.

conflictPolicy.description: How to resolve name conflicts. The prefs format takes Error, Skip, Overwrite or Append, default Overwrite. The xml and legacyPRF formats take Error, Skip, OverwriteExisting or RenameNew, default Error.

firstConflictName.description: Set when conflictPolicy=Error and a name collided; absent otherwise.

importPath.description: The os path to the bcf file, including it's name.

alignBySurveyPoint.description: Align BCF views by Archicad Survey Point or Archicad Project Origin.

pdfFilePath.description: The os path to the PDF file with the markups, including it's name.

issues.description: The issues the import created. Empty when the import failed.

xml.description: A Property Manager export (XML) to import.

nodeCoordinates.description: The corner points of the connected segment chain. Each consecutive pair of points becomes one segment, so a room with four walls needs five points to be closed, or four to be left open.

depth.description: How far each segment looks. Applied to every segment. Defaults to 1.0.

name.description: Name of the interior elevation. Each segment is named after it.

id.description: ID string of the interior elevation.

floorIndex.description: The story to place the interior elevation on. Defaults to the current story.

results.description: One item for each given string, in the same order: true if Archicad accepts the string for use in GDL, false otherwise.

IssueCommentStatus.description: The status of an issue comment.

IssueElementType.description: The attachment type of an element component of an issue.

KeynoteAutoTextTokens.description: The autotext tokens of a keynote item. A token can be used as the text content of a label to reference the field of the keynote item.

KeynoteAutoTextTokensOrError.description: The autotext tokens of a keynote item or an error.

KeynoteAutoTextTokensOrErrors.description: A list of keynote autotext tokens or errors.

parentFolderId.description: The parent folder. Optional; defaults to the root folder.

KeynoteFolderDetails.description: The details of a keynote folder, including its subfolders and items recursively.

KeynoteFolderIdOrError.description: A keynote folder identifier or an error.

parentFolderId.description: The parent folder. Optional; defaults to the root folder.

KeynoteItemDetails.description: The details of a keynote item.

KeynoteItemId.description: The identifier of a keynote item.

KeynoteItemIdOrError.description: A keynote item identifier or an error.

position.description: The reference point of the label.

contentFields.description: The keynote fields to include in the label text as autotext. Optional; defaults to all fields.

LabelArrowType.description: Arrow head shape for a Label's leader line.

LabelData.description: The parameters of the new Label.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

parentElementId.description: The parent element if the label is an associative label.

labelClass.description: Optional; if omitted, inherits the current Label tool default (which may silently resolve to either class - explicitly setting this avoids ambiguity). 'Symbol' needs a symbol library part, which only the Label tool default or the favorite given in favoriteName can provide: when those are a Text label, the item fails instead of placing a label without content.

text.description: The text content if the label is a text label. Newlines create multiple lines; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF. Ignored if 'runs' is also given.

runs.description: Multi-style text content for a text label: an array of styled runs, concatenated in order. Takes precedence over 'text' if both are given.

begCoordinate.description: The begin coordinate of leader line. Optional parameter, but either begCoordinate or parentElementId must be provided. Unless midCoordinate and endCoordinate are both given too, the label is created at its default position relative to the parent element (Archicad's 'createAtDefaultPosition'), so the label may not end up at begCoordinate - read it back with GetDetailsOfElements after creation.

midCoordinate.description: The mid coordinate of leader line. Optional parameter; give it together with endCoordinate to place the label exactly where the coordinates say.

endCoordinate.description: The end coordinate of leader line. Optional parameter; give it together with midCoordinate to place the label exactly where the coordinates say.

floorInd.description: The identifier of the floor. Optional parameter, by default the current floor or the floor of the parent element is used.

rawText.description: Present only when labelClass is 'Text' and Archicad's autotext flag could be switched for the read: the text content read with that flag turned off, so an autotext shows its key (e.g. '<PROJECTNUMBER>') instead of its value.

paragraphCount.description: Present only when labelClass is 'Text'. Read-only: number of paragraphs in the memo (Tapir's own Create/Modify commands always produce 1).

runs.description: Present only when labelClass is 'Text' and the content has paragraphs (always for content Tapir created): one entry per styled run, a single run too.

LabelLeaderLineAnchorPoint.description: How the leader line connects to the label text.

LabelLeaderLineDetails.description: Full readable leader-line/frame state of a Label: every field of LabelLeaderLineSettableDetails plus the leader line's coordinates.

penIndex.description: Pen attribute index of the leader line.

lineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the leader line.

contourOffset.description: Padding between the Label's frame and its content, in mm.

framed.description: Put a frame around the content.

hasLeaderLine.description: Whether the Label has a leader line (pointer line).

squareRootAngle.description: Angle in radians, used only when leaderShape is 'SquareRoot'. Valid range 1-179 degrees.

hideWithBaseElem.description: Hide the label together with its parent element.

LabelLeaderLineSettableDetails.description: Every user-configurable leader-line/frame/arrow setting of a Label (top-level API_LabelType fields, shared by both Text and Symbol label classes). Shared by CreateLabels ('leaderLine'), ModifyLabels ('leaderLine'), and the Get response.

penIndex.description: Pen attribute index of the leader line.

lineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the leader line.

contourOffset.description: Padding between the Label's frame and its content, in mm.

framed.description: Put a frame around the content.

hasLeaderLine.description: Whether the Label has a leader line (pointer line).

squareRootAngle.description: Angle in radians, used only when leaderShape is 'SquareRoot'. Valid range 1-179 degrees.

hideWithBaseElem.description: Hide the label together with its parent element.

LabelSymbolStyleSettableDetails.description: Every user-configurable style setting specific to a Symbol-class Label (top-level API_LabelType fields documented as 'for symbol labels only'). Shared by CreateLabels ('symbolStyle'), ModifyLabels ('symbolStyle'), and the Get response.

fontName.description: Name of the font, as the Font attributes carry it. On input resolved to the font's index like a Text style's fontName, taking precedence over fontIndex, and failing when no loaded font has the name; on read-back the name of the font fontIndex refers to, absent when no loaded font has that index.

backgroundFillPenIndex.description: Effective only if useBackgroundFill is true.

LampData.description: The parameters of the new Lamp.

libraryPartName.description: The name of the lamp library part to use.

fixPoint.description: 0-based index of the hotspot to keep fixed (raw API_ObjectType.fixPoint value, not 1-based).

offset.description: Offset of the symbol's origin from the insertion point. useFixedAngle.description: Use a fixed rotation angle. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify.

lightColor.description: Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify (Get always reports the library part's own default light color). lightIsOn (the on/off state, as opposed to the color) does not have this problem.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from the coordinate's z value.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

offset.description: Offset of the symbol's origin from the insertion point. useFixedAngle.description: Use a fixed rotation angle. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify.

lightColor.description: Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify (Get always reports the library part's own default light color). lightIsOn (the on/off state, as opposed to the color) does not have this problem.

LayerAttributeOrError.description: A layer attribute or an error.

LayerCombinationAttributeDetails.description: The details of the layer combination attribute.

attributeId.description: The identifier of the layer combination attribute.

attributeIndex.description: The index identifier of the layer combination attribute.

name.description: The name of the layer combination.

LayerCombinationAttributeOrError.description: A layer combination attribute or an error.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing Layer to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

index.description: Index of the existing Layer to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing Layer with the given name will be overwritten.

intersectionGroupNr.description: Intersection group. Elements on layers having the same group will be intersected.

LayersOfLayerCombination.description: List of Layers included in the Layer Combination.

attributeId.description: The identifier of the Layer attribute.

isHidden.description: Visibility of the Layer in the Layer Combination.

isLocked.description: Lock state of the Layer in the Layer Combination.

isWireframe.description: Is wireframe mode forced for the Layer in the Layer Combination.

intersectionGroupNr.description: Intersection group of the Layer in the Layer Combination. Elements on layers having the same group will be intersected.

previousNavigatorItemId.description: The sibling after which the new layout is placed, as in MoveNavigatorItem. It must be a child of parentNavigatorItemId (or of the Layout Book root when that is omitted). Cannot be combined with position.

paperWidth.description: Optional paper width in mm, used together with paperHeight. Sets the size of the new layout, and of the master layout when this command creates it from masterLayoutName: a new master starts with the template's default size, which layoutParameters cannot change. An existing master keeps its size. Wins over layoutParameters.horizontalSize.

paperHeight.description: Optional paper height in mm, used together with paperWidth. See paperWidth. Wins over layoutParameters.verticalSize.

customLayoutNumber.description: The layout's own number, used when customLayoutNumbering is true. It only replaces this layout's displayed number: the layout still counts in its subset's numbering, so the sheets after it are renumbered. Use doNotIncludeInNumbering to leave it out.

customLayoutNumbering.description: Use customLayoutNumber instead of the automatic number. Does not leave the layout out of the subset's numbering; see doNotIncludeInNumbering.

doNotIncludeInNumbering.description: Leave the new layout out of its subset's automatic numbering, so the numbers of the other sheets do not change.

LayoutInsertionPosition.description: Where to place the new layout under its parent. Archicad inserts new layouts at the first place, which renumbers the sheets after them; "last" appends it after the existing children instead. Cannot be combined with previousNavigatorItemId.

layoutName.description: The new name of the layout or master layout (its database name, as returned by GetDatabases and GetLayoutSettings). A custom name of its Navigator item is changed with RenameNavigatorItem instead.

masterNavigatorItemId.description: The master layout to assign to the layout, as its Layout Book navigator item. Only layouts can be given a master layout, master layouts cannot.

masterLayoutDatabaseId.description: The master layout to assign to the layout, as its database. Used when masterNavigatorItemId is not given.

masterLayoutName.description: The master layout to assign to the layout, by name. Used when neither masterNavigatorItemId nor masterLayoutDatabaseId is given.

LengthDimensionFormat.description: The format of the linear dimensions.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

showZeroWhole.description: Show the zero before the decimal point of values below one.

showZeroInch.description: Show zero inches in feet and inches values.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

LengthType.description: The type of the length measurement unit.

LevelDimensionData.description: The parameters of the new Level Dimension.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a Level Dimension favorite to base the new element on. Its settings (marker, format, text style, layer, pen) are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

position.description: The location of the marker on the floor plan. With a parentElementId it must lie on that element, the measured level is the parent's height at this point. Outside the parent's outline Archicad still creates the dimension, but without a height (GetDetailsOfElements reads a level of -110000000).

parentElementId.description: Optional element the level dimension is associated with (Mesh, Slab, Roof, Shell, Morph, Beam, Column, Wall, Object, Stair ...). The dimension then shows the element's height at the position and follows the element when it changes. Without it the dimension measures the floor level, or the given static level.

level.description: Optional fixed level value in meters (absolute, from the project zero). Only used without parentElementId; the dimension then shows this value instead of the floor level.

floorIndex.description: The index of the floor to place the dimension on. Optional parameter, by default the floor of the parent element, otherwise the current floor is used.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the dimension on. Optional parameter, by default the layer of the favorite or the Level Dimension tool default is used.

pen.description: Pen index of the marker. Optional parameter.

textHeight.description: Height of the dimension text in millimeters (paper size). Optional parameter.

textPen.description: Pen index of the dimension text. Optional parameter.

dimForm.description: Marker type of the Level Dimension tool, 0-19 as Archicad stores it (read it back with GetDetailsOfElements from an existing level dimension or one placed with a favorite). Optional parameter.

needPlus.description: Show a plus sign for positive values. Optional parameter.

markerSize.description: Size of the marker in millimeters (paper size). Optional parameter.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the marker in radians. Optional parameter.

origin.description: The origin the level is measured from. Optional parameter.

level.description: The level the dimension shows in meters: the height of the owner element at the position for an associative level dimension, the floor level or the static value otherwise.

staticLevel.description: The static flag as Archicad reports it. A level dimension created with a fixed 'level' and no parent keeps that value although Archicad reads this flag as false.

ownerElementId.description: Present only for an associative level dimension: the element it measures.

ownerElementType.description: Present only for an associative level dimension.

textHeight.description: Height of the dimension text in millimeters.

markerSize.description: Size of the marker in millimeters.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the marker in radians.

urlWebLibrary.description: URL of the downloaded Internet library.

mainVersion.description: The main version of the package.

subVersion.description: The sub version of the package.

minArchicadVersion.description: The minimum Archicad version the package needs.

minArchicadBuildNumber.description: The minimum Archicad build number the package needs.

dependencies.description: The packages this package depends on.

name.description: The name of the package.

version.description: The version of the package that is needed.

unId.description: The unique ID of the created library part ('{main}-{revision}'), usable as parentId of further library parts.

guid.description: The main GUID of the created library part, as GetAvailableLibraryParts reports it.

parentName.description: The document name of the parent subtype, e.g. 'General Object' or 'General Label' from the Archicad Library; used when parentId is not given.

type.description: Optional. The type of the new library part. By default the type of the parent found by parentName or by a parentId GUID, and Object otherwise.

path.description: Optional. The relative path of the .gsm file inside the embedded library, the same kind of path AddFilesToEmbeddedLibrary takes as outputPath. By default '<name>.gsm'.

a.description: Optional. The default value of the A (X size) parameter. 1.0 by default.

b.description: Optional. The default value of the B (Y size) parameter. 1.0 by default.

parameterScript.description: Optional. The GDL parameter script (value lists, locks, hiding).

uiScript.description: Optional. The GDL user interface script.

propertiesScript.description: Optional. The GDL properties (component listing) script.

parameters.description: Optional. The parameters of the library part besides A and B, in the order they appear in the settings dialog. Only simple (non-array) parameters can be defined.

LibraryPartMetadata.description: The metadata to set. Only the fields given here are changed, the others are kept.

author.description: The author of the library part.

keywords.description: The keywords of the library part.

license.description: The license of the library part.

password.description: The new password of the library part.

placeable.description: Whether the library part can be placed in the project.

uiDefault.description: The UI Default flag of the library part.

isSubtype.description: Whether the library part is a subtype template.

hierarchicalPagesUsed.description: Whether the library part uses hierarchical pages in its user interface.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

path.description: The path of the file the library part originally came from, e.g. before it was embedded into the project.

name.description: The GDL variable name of the parameter (at most 31 characters).

value.description: Optional. The default value: a number for the numeric and attribute index types, a string for String and Title, true or false for Boolean, 'On' or 'Off' for LightSwitch.

description.description: Optional. The display name of the parameter in the settings dialog.

isHidden.description: Optional. When true, the parameter is hidden from the settings dialog. False by default.

LibraryPartParameterType.description: The type of the parameter, named as GetGDLParametersOfElements reports it.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

deleteScripts.description: Optional. The script sections to delete from the library part. A script cannot be both set in scripts and deleted here.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

deleteScripts.description: Optional. The script sections to delete from the library part. A script cannot be both set in scripts and deleted here.

LibraryPartScripts.description: Optional. The scripts to set. Only the scripts given here are changed, the others are kept. An empty string makes that script section empty, it does not delete it; use deleteScripts for that.

LibraryPartTransformation.description: The transformation chain of the library part instance: placement at location, rotation by angle, then scaling by xRatio and yRatio in the rotated coordinate system.

location.description: The location of the referenced library part on the floor plan.

angle.description: The rotation angle in radians.

xRatio.description: The scaling along the rotated x axis.

yRatio.description: The scaling along the rotated y axis.

LibraryPartType.description: Enumeration of available library part types. 'Unknown' is the schema-valid catch-all returned for any libpart whose typeID is not one of the named values (rare ACAPI sentinels and any future SDK subtype).

LineAttributeOrError.description: A line attribute or an error.

dash.description: Length of the visible part of the item.

gap.description: Length of the invisible part of the item.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing Line to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

index.description: Index of the existing Line to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing Line with the given name will be overwritten.

scaleWithPlan.description: If true, the line type parameters are defined in meters at the given defineScale and scale on printout with the actual plan scale. If false (default), the parameters are fixed values in millimeters as the line will appear on the printout.

defineScale.description: The floor plan scale the line type is defined with. Only used if scaleWithPlan is true.

lineType.description: Solid, Dashed, or Symbol. Defaults to Solid.

period.description: The length of one period (Dashed and Symbol line types).

height.description: The height of the symbol line (Symbol line type only).

dashItems.description: Dash-gap pairs describing one period (Dashed line type only).

lineItems.description: Symbol items describing one period (Symbol line type only).

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line?

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

floorInd.description: The identifier of the floor. Optional parameter, by default the current floor is used.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the line on. Optional parameter, by default the current layer is used.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line? Optional, defaults to false.

linePenIndex.description: Optional pen index. By default the current pen is used.

lineTypeId.description: Optional line type attribute. By default the current line type is used.

itemType.description: Separator, CenterDot, CenterLine, Dot, RightAngle, Parallel, Line, Circle, or Arc.

centerOffset.description: Vertical distance from the origin. Used for Separator, CenterDot, and CenterLine item types.

length.description: Length of the item. Used for CenterLine, RightAngle, and Parallel item types.

begPos.description: Beginning position. Used for Dot, RightAngle, Parallel, Line, Circle, and Arc item types.

endPos.description: End position. Used for Line item type only.

radius.description: Radius. Used for Circle and Arc item types.

beginAngle.description: Beginning angle in radians, measured from the vertical axis. Used for Arc item type only.

endAngle.description: End angle in radians, measured from the vertical axis. Used for Arc item type only.

links.description: The links to create, each from one element to another.

executionResults.description: One result per link, aligned with the input.

LinkToSettings.description: Mode of linking an element to its home story.

homeStoryDifference.description: Difference of the home story from the current story.

newCreationMode.description: Controls home-story selection during element creation. If true, homeStoryDifference selects the home story relative to the current story and the element's absolute floor index is ignored. If false, the absolute floor index is used and Archicad fills homeStoryDifference. This is a creation instruction, not a persistent linking mode.

linkByCriteria.description: Link the property objects matching their criteria to the element.

individualLibraryPartIndex.description: The index of the library part of the property object to assign to the element individually, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. 0 removes the individually assigned property object.

elementType.description: Set the links of the element defaults of this type instead of an element.

linkByCriteria.description: Link the property objects matching their criteria to the element defaults.

individualLibraryPartIndex.description: The index of the library part of the property object to assign to the element defaults individually, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. 0 removes the individually assigned property object.

LockableObjectSetStatus.description: Free: nobody has reserved it. Editable: the current user has reserved it. Locked: another user has reserved it (see conflicts). NotAvailable: the Teamwork server is offline or not available. NotExist: there is no Teamwork connection, for example the project is not a Teamwork project. An unknown object set name is reported as an error, not as a status.

LowCeilingAreaReduction.description: Up to three ceiling height limits split a zone into height ranges; the area of each range is reduced by its own percent in the calculated area of the zone.

activeHeightLimits.description: How many of the three height limits are in use: 0 (no reduction) to 3.

heightLimits.description: The three height limits, each with the reduction of the area under it (and above the previous limit); the first activeHeightLimits of them are in use. In SetProjectPreferences the given items change the limits of the same index.

reductionPercentAboveHeightLimits.description: The reduction of the area above the highest height limit, in percent.

LowCeilingAreaReductionUpdate.description: Up to three ceiling height limits split a zone into height ranges; the area of each range is reduced by its own percent in the calculated area of the zone.

activeHeightLimits.description: How many of the three height limits are in use: 0 (no reduction) to 3.

reductionPercentAboveHeightLimits.description: The reduction of the area above the highest height limit, in percent.

connectToId.description: The MEP element or routing element to connect to.

MEPConnectionResult.description: The result of connecting an MEP routing element: the routing element deleted by merging, the routing element created by splitting and the branch element created by the connection. Empty in Archicad 27, which does not report them.

MEPConnectionResultOrError.description: The result of an MEP connection or an error.

MEPConnectionResultsOrErrors.description: A list of MEP connection results or errors.

MEPConnectionStyle.description: How the pieces of an MEP routing segment, or an MEP port, are connected.

MEPCrossSectionShape.description: Shape of an MEP routing segment's cross section or of an MEP port.

MEPCutPlanePosition.description: Where the floor plan cut plane of an MEP routing element is. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPDomainOrUnknown.description: The reported MEP domain. Unknown indicates that the domain could not be determined.

preferenceTableId.description: The guid of an elbow preference table of the domain (see GetMEPPreferenceTables with includeFittingTables).

factorRadius.description: The radius factor of the elbows placed at the nodes.

angle.description: In degrees. Available from Archicad 29.

type.description: The type of the MEP element.

domain.description: The MEP domain of the element. Empty for domain-independent elements (e.g. Equipment).

localizedTypeName.description: The type name of the element in the language of Archicad. Only returned by Archicad 28.

domain.description: Required for all types except Equipment.

orientationDirection.description: Optional direction vector of the orientation. Defaults to (1, 0, 0).

orientationRotation.description: Optional rotation vector of the orientation. Defaults to (0, 1, 0).

MEPElementDefaults.description: Optional changes to the tool default before the element is placed. Only what is placed changes, not the tool's settings. A value that cannot be set gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed.

removeInsulation.description: If true, the element is placed without insulation. Cannot be combined with insulationThickness.

domain.description: The MEP domain (Ventilation, Piping or CableCarrier), empty if the element has none.

insulationThickness.description: The insulation thickness. RigidSegment, Elbow, Branch and Transition.

routingSegmentId.description: The routing segment the rigid segment belongs to (see GetMEPRoutingElements). RigidSegment.

routingNodeId.description: The routing node the elbow or transition belongs to (see GetMEPRoutingElements). Elbow and Transition.

controlPoints.description: The control points of the flexible segment. FlexibleSegment.

factorRadius.description: The radius factor of the elbow (Elbow::GetFactorRadius). Elbow, from Archicad 29.

preferenceTableId.description: The guid of the elbow or transition preference table (see GetMEPPreferenceTables). Elbow and Transition, from Archicad 29.

branchAngle.description: The angle of the branch, as returned by Branch::GetBranchAngle. Branch.

branchLength.description: The length of the branch. Branch.

offsetY.description: The Y offset of the transition (Transition::GetOffsetY). Transition.

offsetZ.description: The Z offset of the transition (Transition::GetOffsetZ). Transition.

widerPortId.description: The port at the wider end of the transition (see GetMEPPorts). Transition.

narrowerPortId.description: The port at the narrower end of the transition (see GetMEPPorts). Transition.

isControlledByPreference.description: Whether the transition is controlled by its preference table. Transition, from Archicad 29.

MEPElementPorts.description: The ports of an MEP element.

MEPElementPortsOrError.description: The ports of an MEP element or an error.

MEPOnStoryVisibility.description: On which stories an MEP routing element is shown. Available from Archicad 29.

systemGroupId.description: The system group the new physical system belongs to.

rootElementId.description: The MEP element the system starts from. Archicad keeps it only while it is part of an MEP network: the root of a stand-alone element is cleared when the MEP networks are recalculated.

mepSystemId.description: The MEP system attribute used as the category of the physical system.

mepSystemId.description: The MEP system attribute used as the category of the system. Missing when not set.

MEPPhysicalSystemId.description: The identifier of an MEP physical system.

name.description: The new name of the physical system.

nominalSize.description: The nominal size of a piping port. Available from Archicad 30.

MEPPreferenceRowChange.description: Changes one row of a preference table, in the shape GetMEPPreferenceTables returns. Only the given values are changed. A value that does not belong to the kind of table is an error; the read-only values (reference ids, branchAxisAngle, isValid, and angle of an elbow table) are ignored.

delete.description: Deletes the row. The circular segment tables, and the elbow tables in Archicad 28, have a fixed row for each reference id; there the row is emptied instead. Cannot be combined with new values.

value.description: Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables. These tables keep their rows ordered by value, so a changed value can move the row; the indices of the other rows given in the same call are followed.

length.description: Branch tables and piping transition tables.

angle.description: Ventilation transition tables, in the unit GetMEPPreferenceTables returns it. Read-only (ignored) in elbow tables.

key.description: The key of a row. Segment tables: referenceId. Elbow tables: referenceId and angle. Branch tables: mainAxisReferenceId, branchAxisReferenceId and branchAxisAngle. Transition tables: beginReferenceId and endReferenceId. The angles are as GetMEPPreferenceTables returns them; Archicad 28 finds the rows by their reference ids only and rejects a key with an angle. Archicad 27: shape and index (AddMEPPreferenceTableRows: shape only).

valid.description: Whether the row is valid. Archicad 27: whether the list of the shape has a row with the index.

values.description: The values of a row, lengths in meters. Segment tables: diameter, wallThickness and description. Elbow tables: diameter, radius and description. Duct transition tables: beginDiameter, endDiameter, angle and description. Archicad 27: value and description.

MEPPreferenceRowKey.description: The key of a row. Segment tables: referenceId. Elbow tables: referenceId and angle. Branch tables: mainAxisReferenceId, branchAxisReferenceId and branchAxisAngle. Transition tables: beginReferenceId and endReferenceId. The angles are as GetMEPPreferenceTables returns them; Archicad 28 finds the rows by their reference ids only and rejects a key with an angle. Archicad 27: shape and index (AddMEPPreferenceTableRows: shape only).

index.description: Archicad 27 only: the index of the row in the list of its shape, from 0.

MEPPreferenceRowShape.description: Archicad 27 only: the shape whose list of values the row is in.

key.description: The key of a row. Segment tables: referenceId. Elbow tables: referenceId and angle. Branch tables: mainAxisReferenceId, branchAxisReferenceId and branchAxisAngle. Transition tables: beginReferenceId and endReferenceId. The angles are as GetMEPPreferenceTables returns them; Archicad 28 finds the rows by their reference ids only and rejects a key with an angle. Archicad 27: shape and index (AddMEPPreferenceTableRows: shape only).

values.description: The values of a row, lengths in meters. Segment tables: diameter, wallThickness and description. Elbow tables: diameter, radius and description. Duct transition tables: beginDiameter, endDiameter, angle and description. Archicad 27: value and description.

index.description: Archicad 27 only: the index of the row after the call, which can differ from the index of its key when setting a value moves rows. The keys are the indices before the call.

MEPPreferenceRowValues.description: The values of a row, lengths in meters. Segment tables: diameter, wallThickness and description. Elbow tables: diameter, radius and description. Branch tables: mainAxisDiameter, branchAxisDiameter, length, branchOffset, connectionLength and description. Pipe transition tables: beginDiameter, endDiameter, length and description. Duct transition tables: beginDiameter, endDiameter, angle and description. Archicad 27: value and description.

value.description: Archicad 27 only: the value of the row.

isEditable.description: Whether the table can be edited.

useIndividualSegmentLengths.description: Whether the table uses individual segmentation lengths. Available from Archicad 29.

guid.description: The guid of the table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables.

name.description: The new name of the table.

useIndividualSegmentLengths.description: Segment tables only. Available from Archicad 29.

minimumSegmentationLength.description: Segment tables only; the maximum is kept when not given. Available from Archicad 29.

maximumSegmentationLength.description: Segment tables only; the minimum is kept when not given. Available from Archicad 29.

rows.description: The rows to change or delete, each at most once. All indices refer to the table before this call.

newRows.description: Rows to add to a rectangular duct or cable carrier segment table, after the other changes. Adding rows to the other tables is not supported yet.

domain.description: The MEP domain of a preference table container.

tableId.description: The id of a preference table, for the tableId of the preference table row commands.
The id of a preference table, for the tableId of the preference table row commands.

referenceIdDetails.description: The reference ids of the set in the same order as referenceIds, each with whether it is defined.

nodeCoordinates.description: The corner points of the route polyline.

crossSectionWidth.description: Optional cross section width applied to all segments.

crossSectionHeight.description: Optional cross section height applied to all segments.

crossSectionReferenceId.description: Optional cross section reference id of the segment preference table (used for circular cross sections). Resolved against preferenceTableId if given, otherwise against the table of the current routing tool default.

preferenceTableId.description: Optional guid of the segment preference table (see GetMEPPreferenceTables) applied to all segments. Not applicable to the CableCarrier domain.

offsetFromHomeStory.description: The offset of the routing element from its home story.

MorphBody.description: A Morph's full body geometry: an indexed vertex list plus one entry per face (polygon). Shared shape between GetDetailsOfElements' output and CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs' input - what Get reports is what Create/Modify accept back. There is no fillet/chamfer operation in the Archicad API - a caller wanting rounded geometry must supply the already-tessellated facets here; edgeOverrides only controls how an existing straight edge is DISPLAYED (hidden/visible/smooth-shaded), not its shape.

bodyType.description: Whether the body is a closed solid or an open surface shell. Reported accurately on Get; on Create/Modify this is set on the element but a confirmed Archicad SDK bug means it may not take effect (bodyType has been observed always coming back Solid regardless of what was requested - see edgeOverrides' note).

isClosed.description: READ-ONLY, Get output only (ignored if sent to Create/Modify). Geometrically computed (Modeler::MeshBody::IsClosedBody): true if every edge in the body has exactly two adjacent faces (a watertight/manifold volume), false if any edge borders only one face (an open shell / has holes or gaps). Distinct from bodyType, which is the caller's declared INTENT (Solid vs Surface) rather than the actual computed geometry - a body can be declared bodyType 'Solid' yet still be geometrically open if a face is missing.

edgeDefault.description: Default display status for every edge that has no entry in edgeOverrides. Reported accurately on Get. On Create/Modify it takes effect from Archicad 29 on, where it is applied to every edge of the element with ACAPI_Element_ChangeMorphEdgeType right after the element is created or changed (e.g. 'HardHidden' hides all edges of a triangulated body). On Archicad 28 and earlier it is set on the element but does not take effect due to the same confirmed Archicad SDK bug as edgeOverrides (element.morph.edgeType is silently discarded by ACAPI_Element_Create/Change).

vertices.description: Flat, indexed vertex list, local to the Morph's own placement (not world coordinates). A Solid body needs at least 4 (a tetrahedron, the minimum closed volume); a Surface body has no closedness requirement at all - the minimum is 2 vertices joined by a single wireEdge (a lone vertex with no edge at all is rejected by Archicad itself, confirmed live) - enforced with a bodyType-aware error message, not by this minItems floor alone.

polygons.description: One entry per face loop (into `vertices`), counterclockwise as seen from outside the body. Optional - a body made entirely of wireEdges (see below) needs none. Set "filled": false on an entry to create only that loop's edges (e.g. the outline of a pyramid's side faces) without an actual filled face.

wireEdges.description: Standalone edges that belong to no face at all (e.g. a bare rectangle outline, or a pyramid with a filled base but wireframe-only sides - set "filled": false on a polygons entry for a whole closed loop like that instead, this is for individual edges not already covered by any polygon loop). Reported accurately by GetDetailsOfElements (every edge with zero adjacent faces); accepted back by CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs. Identifies an edge by the (unordered) pair of vertex indices it connects - reuses whatever edge already exists between those two vertices if the polygons above happen to share it.

edgeOverrides.description: READ-ONLY in practice: reported accurately by GetDetailsOfElements (reflecting whatever Archicad itself currently has), but CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs silently ignore this field on input - per-edge display status cannot be set by an add-on due to a confirmed, still-unresolved Archicad SDK bug (element.morph.edgeType/bodyType are silently discarded by ACAPI_Element_Create/Change; see the GRAPHISOFT community forum thread 'Help with setting morph's hidden edges in the API'). To hide or smooth ALL edges of a Morph use edgeDefault, which does take effect from Archicad 29 on. Sparse when present - only edges whose display status differs from edgeDefault get an entry. Identifies an edge by the (unordered) pair of vertex indices it connects.

smooth.description: Shade the two adjacent faces smoothly across this edge instead of as a hard crease - the 'aide a la courbe' rounded-look hint. Does not change actual geometry.

silhouetteOnly.description: Show this edge's line only where it forms a silhouette/contour from the current viewpoint.

size.description: Builds a simple axis-aligned box of this size. Mutually exclusive with `body` - give exactly one of the two.

body.description: Builds arbitrary geometry instead of a simple box. Mutually exclusive with `size` - give exactly one of the two.

topExpansion.description: Only used with `size` (box) morphs. Expands the top rectangle outwards on all four sides by this amount, creating a frustum (e.g. sloped excavation shape). 0 creates a cuboid.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from the basePoint's z value.

origin.description: Translation component of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's origin column).

xAxis.description: X axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's first column). Omit on Create to get an identity rotation; give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

yAxis.description: Y axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's second column). Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

zAxis.description: Z axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's third column). Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

buildingMaterialId.description: The Morph's building material - a single, whole-volume property (what the mass is 'made of', governing cut-fill/quantity takeoff), NOT settable per face. Per-face appearance is controlled separately by each polygon's own surfaceId (see MorphBody) - confirmed live these are two independent, unrelated attributes (a Morph can have one uniform building material while showing a different Surface finish on each face).

surfaceId.description: The Morph's own default Surface (element.morph.material) - used for any face that has no per-face surfaceId override of its own (see MorphBody polygons[].surfaceId). Distinct from buildingMaterialId (the whole-volume material). Confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this specific field when set through ACAPI_Element_Create alone (reproduced identically on Archicad 27 and 29 - not a version-specific issue, unlike polygons[].surfaceId below); CreateMorphs works around this transparently with an internal follow-up Change right after Create, so this field behaves correctly end-to-end despite the underlying quirk.

castShadow.description: Whether the body casts shadow in 3D.

receiveShadow.description: Whether the body receives shadow in 3D.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true, the per-story visibility (showContour/showFill) is calculated automatically from the Morph's vertical extent instead of using the explicit values.

showContour.description: Which stories display this Morph's contour. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Create/Modify do not reliably apply it (showAllBelow/showRelAbove/showRelBelow silently come back reset even when explicitly set and isAutoOnStoryVisibility is false) - the same class of confirmed Archicad SDK write bug as bodyType/edgeType/level (see MorphBody's notes). Set on the element regardless since doing so is harmless and forward-compatible.

showFill.description: Which stories display this Morph's floor plan fill. Same write-reliability caveat as showContour.

cutFillPen.description: Overridden cut fill foreground pen (otherwise inherited from the building material). Omit to leave uninherited/unset.

cutFillBackgroundPen.description: Overridden cut fill background pen (otherwise inherited from the building material). Omit to leave uninherited/unset.

cutLineType.description: Line type of the cut contour.

coverFillType.description: Floor plan fill type (only used when useCoverFillType is true).

use3DHatching.description: Derive the floor plan fill from the 3D material instead of coverFillType.

useDistortedCoverFill.description: Show the floor plan hatching as if projected onto a plane.

textureProjectionCoords.description: Texture projection coordinate system: origin, then 3 axis endpoints.

level.description: Z position of the free shape relative to the floor level. Reported accurately on Get, but a confirmed Archicad SDK bug means it may not take effect on Create/Modify (same class of bug as bodyType/edgeType - see MorphBody's notes).

vertexIds.description: Counterclockwise outer-loop vertex indices for this face.

filled.description: Defaults to true. Set to false to create only this loop's edges (a wireframe outline, e.g. a bare rectangle with no surface fill) without an actual face - holes/surfaceId are ignored in that case, since there is no fill for them to apply to.

holes.description: Optional hole loops cut out of this face, each a clockwise list of vertex indices.

surfaceId.description: Optional per-face surface (render material) override. Uses the Morph's default surface when omitted. Ignored during creation in Archicad 25.

xAxis.description: Replaces the rotation part of the placement transform outright. Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together. If rotationDegreesZ is also given in the same call, it is applied first and this then overwrites its result.
