ProfileData.description: Data to create or modify a Profile. Its geometry (the cross-section shape) comes from sourceAttributeId (an existing Profile's geometry, copied), from newSkins (AC27+ only, caller-supplied polygon geometry), or both combined. When creating a brand-new Profile (overwriteExisting false, or true but no existing match), at least one of the two must be given. When overwriteExisting targets an existing Profile, both are optional - the existing Profile's own current geometry is preserved by default (e.g. to change only wallType, or to add newSkins on top of the unchanged existing shape). skinOverrides and newSkins' edgeOverrides target skins/edges by the identifiers/indices GetProfiles reports.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing Profile to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

index.description: Index of the existing Profile to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing Profile with the given name will be overwritten.

sourceAttributeId.description: Identifier of an existing Profile whose geometry (cross-section shape) will be copied as the starting point. Optional if newSkins is given: omit it to build the Profile's geometry entirely from newSkins instead of copying anything (AC27+ only).

wallType.description: Profile available for walls. Defaults to the source Profile's value.

beamType.description: Profile available for beams. Defaults to the source Profile's value.

coluType.description: Profile available for columns. Defaults to the source Profile's value.

handrailType.description: Profile available for handrails. Defaults to the source Profile's value.

otherGDLObjectType.description: Profile available for other GDL based objects. Defaults to the source Profile's value.

skinOverrides.description: Modifications to apply to specific skins of the copied geometry, e.g. to change a skin's building material without rebuilding the profile's shape. Each skinId comes from a prior GetProfiles call's skins[].skinId on the source Profile (or, when overwriteExisting is true, on the Profile being overwritten).

skinId.description: Identifies which skin to modify, from GetProfiles' skins[].skinId.

edgeOverrides.description: Modifications to specific edges of this skin, targeted by their position (0-based) in GetProfiles' skins[].edges.

newSkins.description: AC27+ only. Adds brand-new skins built from caller-supplied polygon geometry, instead of (or in addition to) whatever was copied from sourceAttributeId. Combine with sourceAttributeId to add skins to a copied Profile, or omit sourceAttributeId to build a Profile's geometry entirely from newSkins.

replaceSkins.description: AC27+ only. When overwriteExisting targets an existing Profile, discard every one of its existing skins (and any sourceAttributeId geometry given alongside it) before applying newSkins, instead of adding newSkins on top of the preserved existing geometry. Use this to fully replace a Profile's cross-section with a caller-authored shape while keeping its guid and scalar fields (wallType etc.) - e.g. to sync a Profile's geometry from another project, where sourceAttributeId can't be used because it only resolves within the same file. Also discards any existing profileModifiers, since those are tied to the specific geometry being replaced. Ignored when creating a brand-new Profile (there is nothing to discard yet).

ProfileEdge.description: One edge of a profile skin's outline.

ProfileModifier.description: A stretchable edge-offset parameter of the profile, as named by the profile's author in the Profile Editor. Its value is a live geometric measurement matching what the Profile Editor's dimension shows.

name.description: User-authored label, e.g. 'Largeur support'. Present only if the profile's author assigned one.

value.description: Present only when the parameter's dimension anchors could be resolved to concrete positions.

ProfileSkin.description: One skin (hatch) of the profile's cross-section.

skinId.description: Internal identifier of this skin, stable for the lifetime of the profile. Pass it back in CreateProfiles' skinOverrides to target this skin for modification.

outlineCoords.description: The skin's outline polygon vertices, present only when the skinOutlines field is requested alongside skins.

outlineSubPolyEnds.description: Index (into outlineCoords) of the last vertex of each contour, for skins whose outline has holes or multiple contours.

outlineArcs.description: Marks which consecutive outlineCoords pairs are connected by an arc instead of a straight edge.

polygonArcs.description: Optional arcs along this contour's edges. begIndex/endIndex are 0-based positions within this contour's own polygonCoordinates.

ProfileSkinData.description: One new skin (hatch). Its shape is one or more closed polygon contours: the first is the outer boundary, any further ones are holes cut out of it - the same polygon+holes convention as e.g. CreateSlabs' polygonCoordinates/polygonArcs/holes, just expressed as a list of contours instead of a separate holes array.

contours.description: Closed polygon contours forming this skin's cross-section, in the Profile's local coordinate system. Each contour is closed automatically - do not repeat its first vertex at the end.

edgeOverrides.description: Per-edge pen/visibility/line type, targeted by 0-based edge index. Edge indices follow the same order as this skin's contours/polygonCoordinates: the outer contour's edges first (one edge per vertex, wrapping around), then each hole's, in the order the contours were given. Verify exact indices for a created skin via a follow-up GetProfiles call's skins[].edges before relying on them.

attributesByType.description: One item per requested attribute type, in the order of attributeTypes.

name.description: The name of the project data.

guid.description: The identifier of the add-on object that stores the project data.

clientOnly.description: True when the project data is kept on this client only and is not shared in Teamwork.

teamworkOwner.description: The Teamwork user who has reserved the project data. Omitted when nobody has reserved it or the project is not a Teamwork project.

name.description: The name of the project data.
The name of the project data.

content.description: The content of the project data.

name.description: The name of the project data.

content.description: The content of the project data, for example a JSON string.

clientOnly.description: Creates the project data on this client only, it is not shared in Teamwork. Used only when the project data is created. The default is false.

unique.description: Creates the project data as a unique add-on object: in Teamwork only one can exist with its name, even when several users create it at the same time. Used only when the project data is created, and cannot be combined with clientOnly. The default is false.

projectInfoId.description: The id of the project info field.

projectInfoName.description: The name of the project info field visible on UI.

projectInfoValue.description: The value of the project info field.

projectInfoName.description: Display name of the project info field.

projectInfoValue.description: Initial value of the project info field.

ProjectInfoFieldId.description: The identifier of a field of a Project Info group. It is not the autotext key that GetProjectInfoFields returns as projectInfoId. Available from Archicad 30.

ProjectInfoFields.description: A list of project info fields.

name.description: The name of the group.

fields.description: The fields of the group in their order, including the subfields of calculated fields (e.g. the address components of a full address field).

name.description: The name of the new group. It must not be used by another group.
The name of the field visible on UI.

value.description: The value of the field. The value of a field with subfields is calculated from the subfields.

projectInfoId.description: The autotext key of the field, as GetProjectInfoFields returns it and SetProjectInfoField takes it. Given when exactly one project info autotext has the name of the field, omitted otherwise.

ProjectInfoGroupId.description: The identifier of a Project Info group. Available from Archicad 30.

ProjectInfoGroupIdOrError.description: A Project Info group identifier or an error.

ProjectInfoGroupIdsOrErrors.description: A list of Project Info group identifiers or errors.

beforeProjectInfoGroupId.description: The group to move the group before. When omitted, the group is moved to the end of the group list.

name.description: The new name of the group. It must not be used by another group.

ProjectInfoGroups.description: The Project Info groups in their order in the Project Info dialog. Available from Archicad 30.

PropertyAvailabilityUpdate.description: Classification items the property is available for: set replaces the list, add and remove edit it.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the new property. Optional; when omitted, the default value is Undefined.

availability.description: The identifiers of classification items the new property is available for.

group.description: The property group defined by name or id. If both fields exists the id will be used.

PropertyDefinitionArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing a property definition

name.description: New name of the property.

groupId.description: Move the property into this custom property group.

defaultValue.description: New default value: a basic value or expressions. Switching between the two is allowed.

expressions.description: The new expression strings for the property. Only for expression-based properties.

possibleEnumValues.description: Values already on the property keep their identifier, so element values assigned to them survive; values not listed here are kept as well.

renameEnumValues.description: Change the text of existing enum options. The option keeps its identifier, so element values follow the new text.

removeEnumValues.description: Enum options to remove. Elements holding a removed option lose that value.

enumOrder.description: Every option's display text, once, in the new order (applied after rename, remove and add).

isExpressionBased.description: True if the property value is computed from an expression.

expressions.description: The expression strings of an expression-based property. Only present when isExpressionBased is true.

defaultValueDisplay.description: The basic default value as text. Only for custom, non expression-based properties whose default is set.

availability.description: Classification items a custom property is available for.

defaultEnumValueIds.description: The option guids an enumeration property's default holds. Only for custom enumeration properties whose default is set.

PropertyGroupArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing a property group

PropertyGroupId.description: The identifier of a property group.

PropertyGroupIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property group identifier.

PropertyIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property identifier.

PropertyImportConflictPolicy.description: What to do with a property whose name already exists in its group: append imports it under a new unused name, replace replaces the existing definition, skip keeps the existing one.

elementType.description: Read the links of the element defaults of this type instead of an element.

PropertyValue.description: The string value of a property, formatted according to the command's options.

PropertyValueArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property value.

isAvailable.description: Whether the property is available for the element. Only returned when includeAvailability is true.

PropertyValueDetails.description: A normal, userUndefined, notAvailable or notEvaluated property value.

PropertyValueErrorItem.description: An error in place of a property value.

isAvailable.description: Whether the property is available for the element. Only returned when includeAvailability is true.

PropertyValueOrErrorItem.description: A property value or an error

PropertyValuesArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property values.

PropertyValuesOrError.description: A list of property values or an error.

PropertyValuesOrErrorArray.description: A list of property value lists.

publisherSetName.description: The name of the publisher set.

outputPath.description: Full local or LAN path for publishing. Optional, by default the path set in the settings of the publisher set will be used.

selectedNavigatorItemIds.description: Optional publisher-tree navigator items to publish instead of the whole publisher set.

RailingData.description: The parameters of the new Railing. Everything not given here - the posts, rails, handrails, toprails, panels and balusters - comes from the favorite or from the Railing tool defaults of the open project. Archicad generates one node per vertex and one segment per pair of consecutive vertices from them.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

coordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the reference line of the railing on the floor plan. Each pair of consecutive coordinates becomes one straight segment.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index (home story) of the railing. The story is made active in the floor plan while the railing is created and the previously active story is restored afterwards. When omitted, the current story.

bottomOffset.description: Optional base height of the railing relative to the floor level. When omitted, the value of the favorite (or of the Railing tool defaults) is kept.

height.description: Optional height of the railing segments. When omitted, the segment height of the favorite (or of the Railing tool defaults) is kept.

referenceLine.description: The 2D coordinates of the reference line of the railing, one per node.

bottomOffset.description: The base height of the railing relative to the floor level.

zCoordinate.description: The absolute elevation of the base of the railing.

height.description: The segment height new segments of the railing are made with (the default segment).

segmentHeights.description: The height of each segment of the railing, in the order of the reference line.

regenerate.description: Regenerate the view. The default is false, meaning the view will not be regenerated, but rebuilt.

force.description: Forces the rebuild of GDL-based elements, which runs their parameter script. The default is false.

polygons.description: The polygons to regularize, in the format of CreateSlabs (polygonCoordinates, polygonArcs, holes). For CreateHatches, pass the outline of a result as its coordinates and arcs.

withAncestry.description: Also return for every vertex and edge of the results which input vertex or edge it came from. Optional, false by default.

results.description: One item per input polygon, in the order of the request.

polylines.description: The polylines to regularize, in the format of CreatePolylines.

withAncestry.description: Also return for every point and segment of the results which input point or segment it came from. Optional, false by default.

results.description: One item per input polyline, in the order of the request.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the outline, without a closing coordinate.

polygons.description: The valid polygons Archicad made of the input: none, one or more.

coordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the regularized polyline. Empty when nothing valid is left of it.

arcs.description: The arcs of the regularized polyline.

stateId.description: The state to free, as returned by CaptureElementState.

objectSetName.description: The name of the lockable object set, as the Archicad API documents it: BuildingMaterials, Cities, Composites, Favorites, FillTypes, LayerSettingsDialog (layers and layer combinations), LineTypes, MarkupStyles, MEPSystems, ModelViewOptions, OperationProfiles, PenTables, Profiles, ProjectInfo, GeoLocation (project location), PreferencesDialog (project preferences and dimension standards), GraphicOverrides (renovation override styles), Surfaces or ZoneCategories. Other names the Archicad API accepts work too.

names.description: The names of the project data to release.

host.description: The host address of the notification client. If not provided, localhost is used.

port.description: The port number of the notification client.

elementPairs.description: The trimmed element and the roof or shell trimming it, per pair.

elementIFCClassificationReferences.description: The IFC classification references to remove from the elements. Only references stored on the elements (the ones GetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements returns with storedOnly) can be removed.

elementIFCProperties.description: The local IFC properties to remove.

libraryNames.description: The names of the libraries on the server to remove.

serverUrl.description: The URL of the BIMcloud or Teamwork server, e.g. 'https://bimcloud.example.com:22000'.

parentPath.description: The path of the folder on the server that holds the libraries, as shown in BIMcloud Manager.

executionResults.description: One result per library, in the order of the input.

attributeIds.description: The attributes (for example Building Materials) to make the property unavailable for.

solidLinks.description: List of solid element operation links to remove.

attributeFolders.description: The folders to rename, each given by attribute type and path together with its new name.

designOptionCombinations.description: The design option combinations to rename, each with the new name.

designOptionSets.description: The design option sets to rename, each with the new name.

designOptions.description: The design options to rename, each with the new name and/or id. At least one of them must be given.

path.description: The path of the folder to rename, in the format GetFavoriteFolders returns: the folder names from the root down. The root folder cannot be renamed.

newName.description: The new name of the folder.

ruleGroups.description: The rule groups to rename. Their rules and the combinations that contain them are kept.

newId.description: The new ID of the item. On a layout it is the custom layout number (customLayoutNumbering is switched on); on a Project Map section, elevation, interior elevation, detail or worksheet it is the reference ID of the element behind the item; on any other item it is the custom ID of the navigator item (customUiId becomes true).

customName.description: Set to false to drop the custom name of the item, so that it follows the name of its Project Map source again. Cannot be combined with newName.

projectInfoGroups.description: The Project Info groups to rename, each with its new name.

renovationFilterId.description: Identifier of the renovation filter. The same identifier is the renovationFilterGuid of GetViewSettings and SetViewSettings.

name.description: Name of the renovation filter.
The name of the status as the running Archicad shows it (localized).

designOptionSets.description: The design option sets to move, in the order the moves are done.

designOptions.description: The design options to move, in the order the moves are done.

names.description: The names of the project data to request from the users who have reserved them.

mailText.description: The message sent with the request. The default is empty.

conflicts.description: The user whose reservation prevented reserving the Hotlink and XRef management.

objectSetName.description: The name of the lockable object set, as the Archicad API documents it: BuildingMaterials, Cities, Composites, Favorites, FillTypes, LayerSettingsDialog (layers and layer combinations), LineTypes, MarkupStyles, MEPSystems, ModelViewOptions, OperationProfiles, PenTables, Profiles, ProjectInfo, GeoLocation (project location), PreferencesDialog (project preferences and dimension standards), GraphicOverrides (renovation override styles), Surfaces or ZoneCategories. Other names the Archicad API accepts work too.

conflicts.description: The users whose reservation prevented reserving the object set.

names.description: The names of the project data to reserve.

conflicts.description: The project data that could not be reserved because another user has reserved it.

numberOfStepsBack.description: The number of steps to go back in the zoom history of the current window, like Archicad's Zoom Back. The default is 1.

firstRevisionIssueId.description: The identifier of the first issue in which the given change is issued.

customSchemeKey.description: The identifier of the custom field. The same key is used in the customSchemeData of the revision changes.

customSchemeName.description: The name of the custom field.

RevisionChangesArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing an array of revision changes

RevisionChangesOfEntities.description: The revision changes of the requested entities, in the order of the input, or an error for an entity whose changes could not be retrieved.

RevisionIssueId.description: The identifier of a revision issue.

id.description: The new ID of the revision issue.

description.description: The new short description of the revision issue.

customSchemeData.description: The custom scheme fields to set. A field is addressed by its key (as GetRevisionIssues returns it) or by its name; the fields not listed keep their values.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from level.

thickness.description: Only takes effect on a Basic (homogeneous) roof - a Composite roof takes its thickness from the composite attribute. Without structureType the new roof keeps the structure of the roof tool default (or the favorite), which may be a composite; send structureType 'Basic' for the thickness to apply.

pivotLine.description: If given, creates a single-plane roof instead of a multi-plane roof, tilted along this pivot line.

angle.description: Slope angle of the single-plane roof in radians. Only valid together with 'pivotLine'.

level.description: Height of the pivot line (single-plane) or the pivot polygon (multi-plane) above the floor level.

materialsChained.description: Whether the surface materials are chained.

angle.description: Single-plane: the slope in radians.

eavesOverhang.description: Multi-plane: the eaves overhang beyond the pivot polygon.

levels.description: Multi-plane: the roof levels, each with its height above the previous and its slope in radians.

pivotPolygonOutline.description: Multi-plane: the pivot polygon the planes rise from. Arcs are not carried; a curved pivot edge comes back as its end points.

polygonOutline.description: The roof's polygon: the plane roof's outline, the multi-plane roof's contour.

edgeSideMaterials.description: The custom side surface of each edge of the roof's polygon: the edges of polygonOutline first, then those of each hole in order, the item i of a polygon belonging to its edge from vertex i to vertex i + 1.

RoofDetailsPivotLine.description: The pivot line about which a roof plane rotates.

RoofOrShellRelationsOfElement.description: Relations of a roof or shell: the connected zones.

RoofPivotLine.description: A directed pivot line defined by its beginning and end coordinates. The roof plane rises on the left side of the line direction (begCoordinate towards endCoordinate); reverse the direction to tilt towards the other side.

RoofQuantities.description: Quantities of a Roof element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

volumeConditional.description: Conditional net volume of the roof.

topSurface.description: Net top surface of the roof.

bottomSurface.description: Net bottom surface of the roof.

edgeSurface.description: Net surface of the edges of the roof.

topSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional top surface of the roof.

bottomSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional bottom surface of the roof.

grossTopSurface.description: Gross top surface of the roof.

grossBottomSurface.description: Gross bottom surface of the roof.

grossEdgeSurface.description: Gross surface of the edges of the roof.

contourArea.description: Area of the roof contour polygon.

holesSurface.description: Total area of the holes in the roof.

holesPerimeter.description: Total perimeter of the holes in the roof.

openingsSurface.description: Total surface of the roof openings.

ridgesLength.description: Length of the ridge edges (divided by 2, as Archicad reports it).

valleysLength.description: Length of the valley edges (divided by 2, as Archicad reports it).

hipsLength.description: Length of the hip edges (divided by 2, as Archicad reports it).

thickness.description: Only takes effect on a Basic (homogeneous) roof - a Composite roof takes its thickness from the composite attribute. Send structureType 'Basic' in the same call to switch a composite roof first.

beginPoint.description: Starting point of the rotation arc.

endPoint.description: End point of the rotation arc.

copy.description: Optional parameter. If true, a copy of the element is rotated. By default it's false.

checks.description: The Action Center checks to run, in this order. Omitted means ["Hotlinks"]. "Hotlinks" is available on every Archicad version; "All", "Libraries", "Drawings" and "Licenses" only on Archicad 25, later versions return an error for them in their execution result.

moduleFilePath.description: Absolute path of the .mod file to write. An existing file is overwritten. The current window must be a floor plan, section, elevation or detail.

elements.description: Optional. The elements that go into the module; omitted, the current selection does, as Save Selection as Module would. Pass GetAllElements for the whole project. Archicad 25 and 26 support the selection form only.

imageFilePath.description: Absolute path of the image file to write. An existing file is overwritten.

dithered.description: Optional, false by default. Whether the image is dithered when its color depth drops colors.

entireDrawing.description: Optional, false by default. Whether the image covers the entire drawing of a 2D window instead of its current zoom, as the Entire Drawing option of the Save as picture dialog does.

imageFilePath.description: The path of the written image file.

zoom.description: The zoom of the window the image shows, as GetView2DTransformations reports it. Absent for the 3D window.

rotation.description: The orientation of the window in radian, as GetView2DTransformations reports it. Absent for the 3D window.

archiveFilePath.description: Absolute path of the .pla archive to write. An existing file is overwritten. The archive becomes the open project, as Save As does.

includeLibraryParts.description: Optional, true by default. Whether the library parts the project uses go into the archive, which makes the archive usable as a linked library of another project.

includeProperties.description: Optional, true by default. Whether the properties go into the archive.

includeTextures.description: Optional, false by default. Whether the linked textures go into the archive.

includeBackgroundPicture.description: Optional, false by default. Whether the background picture goes into the archive.

projectPath.description: Optional. Full path of a .pln file to save the project to, as File > Save As does: the open project then refers to that file. This saves an untitled project, or one opened from an older Archicad version, which cannot be saved in place. An existing file at the path is overwritten. When omitted, or when it is the project's own file, the project is saved in place, which keeps the refusal of a project opened read-only.

h.description: Horizontal pixel position from the left edge of the view window.

v.description: Vertical pixel position from the top edge of the view window.

h.description: Horizontal pixel position from the left edge of the view window.

v.description: Vertical pixel position from the top edge of the view window.

screenPoints.description: Pixel positions local to the current Archicad view window (not global desktop coordinates).

coordinates.description: One item per input screen point, in the same order: the 2D model coordinate in the current database (meters), or an error. This is a 2D mapping: it does not reconstruct a 3D point, and in a 3D window the result is not a point of the model.

depth.description: The distance of the depth line from the section line, on the left of the start to end direction, which is the direction the section looks in. Default is 1.

SectionDetails.description: The geometry of a Section (CutPlane) marker on the floor plan, the fields CreateSections takes.

name.description: The name of the section.

idStr.description: The reference ID of the section.

mainCoordinates.description: The points of the section line, from start to end. More than two for a broken section line. Empty when the line cannot be read.

depthCoordinates.description: The points of the depth line, the far boundary of the section. Empty when it cannot be read.

startCoordinate.description: The first point of the section line (startCoordinate of CreateSections).

endCoordinate.description: The last point of the section line (endCoordinate of CreateSections).

depth.description: The distance of the first depth point from the first segment of the section line (depth of CreateSections).

viewDirection.description: The unit vector perpendicular to the first segment of the section line, pointing to the side of the depth line: the direction the section looks in. CreateSections puts it to the left of the start to end direction.

cutPlanes.description: The cut planes. An empty array switches the 3D cut off. The side of a plane its normal vector points to is cut away and the other side is kept (to be confirmed in Archicad). pd is in meters.

cutawayEnabled.description: Turns 3D Cutaway on or off. Left unchanged when omitted.

cuttingPlanesVisible.description: Shows or hides the cutting planes. Left unchanged when omitted.

rebuild.description: If true, Archicad drops the partial conversion data, so the next rebuild of the 3D window is a full one. Default: false.

hSize.description: The horizontal size of the 3D window in pixels.

vSize.description: The vertical size of the 3D window in pixels.

zoomScaleX.description: The horizontal zoom scale of the 3D projection.

zoomScaleY.description: The vertical zoom scale of the 3D projection.

zoomDispX.description: The horizontal displacement (pan) of the 3D projection.

zoomDispY.description: The vertical displacement (pan) of the 3D projection.

hSize.description: The horizontal size of the 3D window in pixels.

vSize.description: The vertical size of the 3D window in pixels.

zoomScaleX.description: The horizontal zoom scale of the 3D projection.

zoomScaleY.description: The vertical zoom scale of the 3D projection.

zoomDispX.description: The horizontal displacement (pan) of the 3D projection.

zoomDispY.description: The vertical displacement (pan) of the 3D projection.

activeDesignOptions.description: The list of active design options in the combination.

releases.description: The element and its new release, as GetAnalyticalReleases returns it. The release replaces the element's release as a whole.

visibilitySettings.description: The fields to change. The fields left out keep their current value.

isVisible.description: True shows the Archicad application, false hides it.

attributes.description: The attributes and the built-in property values to set on each.

executionResults.description: One result per given property value, attribute by attribute, in the order of the input. The values of one attribute are written together, so an error of that write is the result of each of them.

elementCategoryValues.description: The category values to set: one element and one category per item. The same element can appear in several items, one per category.

executionResults.description: One result per item of the input, in the same order.

attributeClassifications.description: The classifications to set, one per attribute and classification system.

elementDefaultClassifications.description: The classifications to set on the tool defaults (the settings new elements get).

sceneName.description: The name of the rendering scene to make current, one of the names GetRenderingScenes returns.

scale.description: The denominator of the new drawing scale: 100 for 1:100, 20 for 1:20. Archicad accepts scales between 1 and 30000.

rebuild.description: Rebuild the window after the scale changed (the API's zoom flag). Default: false.

stretches.description: The element of the curve member and the lengths to add to it.

designOptionId.description: The design option to set as the default. When it is not given, the Main Model becomes the default.

id.description: The Element ID (the ID field of the element's Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels). The same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id.

enabled.description: True turns the dialog auto close on: Archicad closes the dialogs it would show with their default button instead of waiting for the user. False turns it off.

SetDocumentFrom3DDefaultsParameters.description: Only the given fields are changed, the rest keep their current default.

name.description: The name of a new 3D Document.

refId.description: The reference ID of a new 3D Document.

intPlanConn.description: The connection of the 3D Document to the model.

materialFrom3D.description: Use the surfaces of the 3D model; when false, cMater is used for every element.

cMater.description: The index of the uniform surface (material), used when materialFrom3D is false.

boundaryDisplay.description: How the boundary contours are displayed.

boundaryPen.description: The pen of the boundary contours, used with OverrideContours.

boundaryLineType.description: The index of the line type of the boundary contours, used with OverrideContours.

attributeOptions.description: The uniform attribute options (cut and uncut surfaces, shading, hidden edges).

host.description: The host address of the notification client. If not provided, localhost is used.

port.description: The port number of the notification client.

notifyOnNewElement.description: Notify on creation of a new element. Optional parameter, by default true.

notifyOnModificationOfAnElement.description: Notify on modification/deletion of an element. Optional parameter, by default true.

notifyOnReservationChanges.description: Notify on reservation changes of an element. Optional parameter, by default true.

elementUserData.description: The elements with the key-value pairs to store on them. Each item needs userData, keysToDelete or both.

executionResults.description: One result per input item, in the input order.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

index1.description: Optional 1-based first index for changing a single item of an array parameter. Only valid for array parameters and only together with a single (non-list) value.

index2.description: Optional 1-based second index for changing a single item of a two-dimensional array parameter. Only valid together with index1. Defaults to 1.

value.description: The new value of the parameter, in the unit GetGDLParametersOfElements reports it in (Angle parameters in radians). For array parameters provide a list of values for one-dimensional arrays (e.g. [1, 2, 3]) or a list of lists for two-dimensional arrays (e.g. [[11, 12], [21, 22]]); the list must contain exactly as many values as the parameter has items, resizing an array parameter is not supported. A two-dimensional array can also be given as a flat list of all its dimension1 x dimension2 items row by row, the layout GetGDLParametersOfElements returns. Alternatively provide index1 (and optionally index2) together with a single value to change one item of the array. Within one command call whole-array (list) values are applied after all single-value changes.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

index1.description: Optional 1-based first index for changing a single item of an array parameter. Only valid for array parameters and only together with a single (non-list) value.

index2.description: Optional 1-based second index for changing a single item of a two-dimensional array parameter. Only valid together with index1. Defaults to 1.

value.description: The new value of the parameter, in the unit GetGDLParametersOfElements reports it in (Angle parameters in radians). For array parameters provide a list of values for one-dimensional arrays (e.g. [1, 2, 3]) or a list of lists for two-dimensional arrays (e.g. [[11, 12], [21, 22]]); the list must contain exactly as many values as the parameter has items, resizing an array parameter is not supported. A two-dimensional array can also be given as a flat list of all its dimension1 x dimension2 items row by row, the layout GetGDLParametersOfElements returns. Alternatively provide index1 (and optionally index2) together with a single value to change one item of the array. Within one command call whole-array (list) values are applied after all single-value changes.

elementsWithGDLParameters.description: The elements with GDL parameters dictionary pairs.

SetGhostStorySettingsParameters.description: Every field is optional; the ones left out keep their current value. A story choice (showOne, showAbove or showBelow true) replaces the current reference, whatever it is; without one the reference is kept, also when it is another view (a section, an elevation, a worksheet).

on.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the ghost story on the floor plan.

showOne.description: Show the story at storyIndex as the ghost story.

showAbove.description: Show the story above the current one as the ghost story.

showBelow.description: Show the story below the current one as the ghost story.

storyIndex.description: The index of the story to show when showOne is true, as GetStories reports it.

ghostColor.description: The color to draw the ghost story in.

filter.description: The element types to show in the ghost story; the others are hidden.

ruleGroupNames.description: The names of the rule groups in their new order. The groups not listed keep their order and follow the listed ones.

graphicOverrideRuleGroups.description: The rule groups to reorder, in the shape GetGraphicOverrideRuleGroups returns them.

elementIFCAttributeValues.description: The IFC attribute values to set.

elementIFCClassificationReferences.description: The IFC classification references to store on the elements.

elementIFCPropertyValues.description: The IFC property values to set. Only single value (IfcPropertySingleValue) properties are supported.

propertySetName.description: The name of the property set, for example Pset_DoorCommon. Custom property set names are also accepted.

propertyName.description: The name of the property, for example FireRating.

type.description: The IFC type of the value, for example IfcLabel, IfcText, IfcIdentifier, IfcBoolean, IfcLogical, IfcInteger, IfcReal or a measure type like IfcThermalTransmittanceMeasure. A type Archicad does not know is rejected.

value.description: The new value of the property. Provide a boolean for IfcBoolean and IfcLogical (IfcLogical also accepts the string Unknown), a number for the numeric types and a string for every other type.

elementTypes.description: The element types to set the last 3D default level of.

levels.description: The new last 3D default level of each element type, in the order of elementTypes, in meters.

libraries.description: Local library folders or container files, by absolute path.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

sectionId.description: The type identifier of the custom section. A four-character code is given as its integer value, the first character in the highest byte (e.g. 'ABCD' is 1094861636).

index.description: Optional. The index of the section among the sections with the same identifier. By default 0.

dataVersion.description: Optional. The data version stored with the section. By default 0. Only used with data.

data.description: The new content of the section, base64 encoded. The section is created when it does not exist, otherwise replaced. Give either data or delete.

delete.description: When true, the section is deleted. Give either data or delete.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to modify and the metadata to set in each.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

deletePreviewPicture.description: Optional. When true, the preview picture is deleted.

deleteDarkPreviewPicture.description: Optional. When true, the preview picture for the dark user interface is deleted. Requires Archicad 29 or newer.

deleteGdlPictures.description: Optional. When true, all GDL pictures are deleted.

deleteDarkGdlPictures.description: Optional. When true, all GDL pictures for the dark user interface are deleted. Requires Archicad 29 or newer.

copy2DSymbolFrom.description: Optional. The name of another loaded library part (fileName with extension); its 2D symbol (the drawn 2D vector image) replaces this part's 2D symbol.

delete2DSymbol.description: Optional. When true, the 2D symbol (the drawn 2D vector image) is deleted. Cannot be combined with copy2DSymbolFrom.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to modify, with the scripts to set and to delete in each.

elementsWithLinkedPropertyObjects.description: The property object links to set, each for an element or for the element defaults of an element type. A link that is not given stays unchanged.

tableId.description: The guid of a preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables (the branch, elbow and transition tables with includeFittingTables): a pipe or circular duct segment table, a branch or elbow table of the Piping or Ventilation domain, or, from Archicad 29, a transition table. Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables are found too, but their rows have no key. Archicad 27: any preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers.

rows.description: The rows to change. Only the given values are set.

executionResults.description: One result per row, in the order of the rows.

elements.description: The routing parameters to change. Only the given keys are changed. An item gives either routingNodeParameters and/or routingSegmentParameters for a routing element, or elbowParameters and/or transitionParameters for a routing node.

elementsWithMarkerParameters.description: The elements with the marker parameters to change.

extrusionParameters.description: The size and extrusion settings to change, with the names GetOpeningDetails returns. The ones left out are not changed.

floorPlanParameters.description: The floor plan settings to change, with the names GetOpeningDefault returns. The ones left out are not changed.

elementType.description: The type of the elements the changed settings are the defaults of.

openingsWithDetails.description: The Opening elements (made with the Opening tool) to change, each with the details to set. A detail that is left out stays as it is.

values.description: The project data to create or to overwrite. Prefix the names with the name of your tool (for example 'my-tool/settings') so different scripts do not overwrite each other's data.

projectInfoId.description: The id of the project info field.

projectInfoValue.description: The new value of the project info field. An empty string clears the field.

dateOfIssue.description: Date of issue (free text, as typed in Project Notes).

SetProjectPreferencesParameters.description: The pages to change, by name. Only the given fields of a page change, the rest keeps its value. In Teamwork the PreferencesDialog lockable object set has to be reserved first (ReserveLockableObjectSet).

SetProjectPreferencesResult.description: One execution result per page given in the input, by name.

suspendGroups.description: Turn the Suspend Groups mode on or off.

elementsWithURLReferences.description: The elements and the web link to set on each.

pairs.description: The key-value pairs to store on each attribute. A key the attribute already holds gets the new value; other keys are left as they are.

executionResults.description: One result per attribute, in the input order.

groups.description: The groups to store the pairs on.

pairs.description: The key-value pairs to store on each group. A key the group already holds gets the new value; other keys are left as they are.

executionResults.description: One result per group, in the input order.

modelViewOptionIndex.description: Switches the window to the model view option combination with this index (see GetModelViewOptions, starting from 1). Without viewOptions only the combination is switched.

automaticLabeling.description: Turns the automatic labeling of Zones (placing a Label on each new Zone) on or off.

favoriteName.description: The name of the Label Favorite that is placed on each new Zone by the automatic labeling.

zoomBox.description: The area to zoom the current 2D window to, in model coordinates (meters). The window keeps its aspect ratio, so the shown area may be larger than the box. The rotation of the window is kept as it is.

ShellQuantities.description: Quantities of a Shell element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

volumeConditional.description: Conditional net volume of the shell.

referenceSurface.description: Net area of the reference surface.

oppositeSurface.description: Net area of the surface opposite to the reference.

referenceSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional area of the reference surface.

oppositeSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional area of the opposite surface.

grossReferenceSurface.description: Gross area of the reference surface.

grossOppositeSurface.description: Gross area of the opposite surface.

floorPlanArea.description: Projected floor plan area of the contour polygon.

alertType.description: The type of the alert dialog.

title.description: The title of the alert dialog.

subMessage.description: Optional smaller sub-message text below the main message.

button2.description: Label for the second button (e.g. Cancel).

button3.description: Label for the optional third button.

clickedButton.description: Index of the button the user clicked: 1 = button1, 2 = button2, 3 = button3.

htmlContent.description: The full HTML document to display in the Script UI palette.

width.description: Optional palette client width in pixels. Leave unset to keep the current size.

height.description: Optional palette client height in pixels. Leave unset to keep the current size.

title.description: Optional palette window title. Leave unset to keep the current title.

resizable.description: Whether the user can drag-resize the palette. Defaults to true.

zoomEnabled.description: Whether Ctrl+scroll/pinch zooming is allowed in the page. Defaults to true.

zoomLevel.description: Optional initial zoom level (1.0 = 100%). Leave unset to keep the current zoom.

scrollBarsVisible.description: Whether the browser's own scrollbars are shown. Defaults to true.

contextMenuEnabled.description: Whether right-click shows the browser's context menu (e.g. Inspect Element). Defaults to true.

navigationDisabled.description: Prevents the page from navigating away (e.g. clicking a link to another site) once it has loaded. Defaults to false.

allowSelfSignedCertificates.description: Only relevant if htmlContent links to a remote https:// resource with a self-signed certificate. Defaults to false.

clearCookies.description: Deletes all browser cookies before loading htmlContent. Defaults to false.

autoHeight.description: Automatically resizes the palette's height to fit the page content as it changes. Defaults to false.

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the outline of the hole, as Archicad returns them. The outline is closed implicitly (the first vertex is not repeated at the end); a curved edge is given by its end points only.

SlabData.description: The parameters of the new Slab.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

layerIndex.description: Optional layer attribute index to place the new element on. It must be an existing, unlocked layer. When omitted the element gets the layer of the favorite or of the tool defaults.

level.description: The Z coordinate value of the reference line of the slab.

thickness.description: Optional slab thickness. Only takes effect on a Basic (homogeneous) slab - a Composite slab takes its thickness from the composite attribute. Without structureType, buildingMaterialId or compositeId the new slab keeps the structure of the slab tool default (or the favorite), which may be a composite; send structureType 'Basic' for the thickness to apply.

structureType.description: Optional structure of the slab. If omitted, derived from buildingMaterialId or compositeId when one is given, otherwise the slab tool default (or the favorite) is kept.

buildingMaterialId.description: Building material of a Basic slab. Cannot be combined with compositeId.

compositeId.description: Composite attribute of a Composite slab. Cannot be combined with buildingMaterialId.

referencePlaneLocation.description: For a basic (homogeneous) slab only 'Top' or 'Bottom' are valid.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the edge of the slab.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the slab.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from level.

level.description: Distance of the reference level of the slab from the floor level.

offsetFromTop.description: Vertical distance between the reference level and the top of the slab.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the slab.

SlabQuantities.description: Quantities of a Slab element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

volumeConditional.description: Conditional net volume of the slab.

topSurface.description: Net top surface of the slab.

bottomSurface.description: Net bottom surface of the slab.

edgeSurface.description: Net surface of the edges of the slab.

topSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional top surface of the slab.

bottomSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional bottom surface of the slab.

grossTopSurface.description: Gross top surface of the slab.

grossBottomSurface.description: Gross bottom surface of the slab.

grossEdgeSurface.description: Gross surface of the edges of the slab.

holesSurface.description: Total area of the holes in the slab.

holesPerimeter.description: Total perimeter of the holes in the slab.

SlabReferencePlaneLocation.description: Location of the slab reference plane.

zCoordinate.description: Absolute Z of the slab's reference level. The home story is derived from it unless floorIndex is given; a Z below the lowest story stays on the lowest story with a negative level.

floorIndex.description: Optional home story index (as returned by GetStories). With zCoordinate it pins the story the Z is resolved against; alone it only changes the home story.

thickness.description: Only takes effect on a Basic (homogeneous) slab - a Composite slab takes its thickness from the composite attribute. Send structureType 'Basic' in the same call to switch a composite slab first.

polygonOutline.description: Replaces the slab's entire polygon, including its holes - resend the holes field too to keep them, otherwise they are removed.

holes.description: Can be given on its own, without polygonOutline, to add/remove/clear holes in place (an empty array clears all holes) - the slab's current outline is reused unchanged.

targetId.description: The element to be cut or modified.

SolidLinkFlags.description: Flags controlling the behaviour of a solid element operation link.

inheritOperatorAttributes.description: If true, the target element inherits the attributes of the operator element.

skipPolygonHoles.description: If true, holes of the operator (roof/slab) are ignored during the operation.

solidLinksWithTheGivenTarget.description: Links where the given element is the target (being cut or modified).

linkTime.description: When the solid link was made, as a date and time string formatted like the times of revision issues. Omitted when Archicad does not report it.

solidLinksWithTheGivenOperator.description: Links where the given element is the operator (performing the cut).

linkTime.description: When the solid link was made, as a date and time string formatted like the times of revision issues. Omitted when Archicad does not report it.

elements.description: The morphs created by the operation.

SolidOperationType.description: The type of solid element operation.

stairsData.description: Array of Stair data to check, with the same fields as the items of CreateStairs (without favoriteName). Nothing is created.

solutions.description: The results of the stair solver, aligned with the input stairsData.

path.description: The path of the special folder in the filesystem.

SpecialFolderPathOrError.description: The path of a special folder or an error.

SpecialFolderPathsOrErrors.description: A list of special folder paths or errors.

SpecialFolderType.description: The type of a special folder of the running Archicad.

SplineData.description: The parameters of the new Spline.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

floorInd.description: The identifier of the floor. Optional parameter, by default the current floor is used.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the spline on. Optional parameter, by default the current layer is used.

coordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the spline points. Do not repeat the first point at the end even for a closed spline.

closed.description: Is this a closed curve? Optional, defaults to false.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line? Optional, defaults to false.

linePenIndex.description: Optional pen index. By default the current pen is used.

lineTypeId.description: Optional line type attribute. By default the current line type is used.

SplineDetails.description: Geometry of a Spline element. Geometry is read-only: Archicad's own API does not support modifying Spline geometry via ACAPI_Element_Change. The settings fields (roomSeparator/linePenIndex/lineTypeId) ARE modifiable via SET.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line?

SplineSettings.description: Settings for modifying a Spline. Only these settings fields are modifiable - Archicad's own API does not support changing Spline geometry (coordinates/closed) via ACAPI_Element_Change.

StairBaselineData.description: The parameters of the Stair to check. Fields that are not given come from the current Stair tool defaults, as in CreateStairs.

baseLinePoints.description: 2D coordinates defining the stair baseline polyline. Minimum 2 points for a straight stair, 3+ for L-shaped or U-shaped stairs.

zCoordinate.description: The Z coordinate (absolute elevation) of the stair base.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from zCoordinate.

finishVisible.description: Optional. If false, the tread/riser finishes are hidden and only the stair structure (e.g. a monolith) is modeled.

baseLinePoints.description: The baseline polyline after the solver ran.

baseLineArcs.description: The arcs of the baseline after the solver ran, indexing baseLinePoints. Present only when the baseline has arcs.

totalHeight.description: Total height of the stair after the solver ran.

flightWidth.description: Width of the stair flight after the solver ran.

stepNum.description: Number of risers after the solver ran.

riserHeight.description: Height of each riser after the solver ran.

treadDepth.description: Depth (going) of each tread after the solver ran.

StairBaselineSolutionState.description: Correct: the baseline was already valid, nothing changed. Solved: the solver turned it into a valid baseline, returned in baseLinePoints. NotSolved: no valid baseline was found; CreateStairs is likely to fail or create an invalid stair with this input.

StairData.description: The parameters of the new Stair.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

baseLinePoints.description: 2D coordinates defining the stair baseline polyline. Minimum 2 points for a straight stair, 3+ for L-shaped or U-shaped stairs.

zCoordinate.description: The Z coordinate (absolute elevation) of the stair base.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from zCoordinate.

finishVisible.description: Optional. If false, the tread/riser finishes are hidden and only the stair structure (e.g. a monolith) is modeled.

StairDetails.description: The settings of a Stair element, the ones CreateStairs takes. The finishes and the structure are modeled by the Stair's subelements (risers, treads and structures), which GetSubelementsOfHierarchicalElements lists.

treadDepth.description: The tread depth (going) stored in the Stair's settings. Archicad does not keep it in step with the modeled treads: a placed stair can read 0 or 1 here, so take the modeled going from the geometry of its treads or risers (Get3DGeometryOfElements) instead.

level.description: Height of the stair base above the home story level.

zCoordinate.description: Absolute elevation of the stair base.

finishVisible.description: Whether the tread/riser finishes are modeled. If false only the stair structure (e.g. a monolith) is.

baseLinePoints.description: The baseline polyline the stair is placed along, in model coordinates, as given to CreateStairs.

baseLineArcs.description: The curved segments of the baseline, present only when it has any.

decimals.description: Number of decimals displayed.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Whether trailing zero decimals are hidden.

decimals.description: Number of decimals displayed.

showSmall5.description: The extra accuracy (small 5) setting of the displayed values, 0 when off, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroWhole.description: Whether a zero whole part is displayed.

showZeroInch.description: Whether zero inches are displayed, as Archicad stores it.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Whether trailing zero decimals are hidden.

StoredGDLParameter.description: A GDL parameter as it is stored with a marker or a Favorite, read without a parameter interface (so without isLocked and possibleValues).

name.description: The name of the parameter.

displayName.description: The display name of the parameter.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of array (in case of array value).

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of array (in case of array value).

value.description: The value of the parameter.

valueDescription.description: The value description for numeric parameter.

itemDescriptions.description: Per-item text labels for an array-type parameter, one per array element in dim1xdim2 order. Only present when the library part defines them.

StoriesParameters.description: A list of project stories, each with their complete parameters.

StoriesSettings.description: A list of story settings, used as input for creating or modifying multiple stories.

StoryParameters.description: Represents all parameters of a single project story, including its unique identifiers. Used in API responses.

index.description: The story index.

dispOnSections.description: Story level lines should appear on sections and elevations.

height.description: Story height, calculated as the level of the story above minus this story's level. The topmost story gets its height from the virtual story that Archicad keeps above it in the story settings; only an Archicad that did not report that virtual story would leave the top story without a height.

name.description: The name of the story.

ifcId.description: The IFC GlobalId of the story, i.e. of the IfcBuildingStorey it is exported as (the same identifier the IFC Project Manager shows). Available from Archicad 28; older versions omit it.

StorySettings.description: Contains the configurable settings for creating or modifying a story. Used as input in API requests.

index.description: The story index. Optional. The stories are matched to the existing ones positionally, from the bottom up. Giving the index of any of them pins the numbering of the whole list, so stories below the existing structure - basements with negative indices - can be requested as well. When given for more than one story, the indices must be consecutive.

dispOnSections.description: Story level lines should appear on sections and elevations.

name.description: The name of the story.

StoryVisibility.description: Per-story visibility settings (API_StoryVisibility): the home story, plus how many stories above/below also show this element.

showAllAbove.description: Show on all stories above the home story.

showAllBelow.description: Show on all stories below the home story.

showRelAbove.description: Show this many stories above the home story (ignored when showAllAbove is true).

showRelBelow.description: Show this many stories below the home story (ignored when showAllBelow is true).

name.description: The name of the 3D style, unique within the project.

engineId.description: The id of the 3D rendering engine (API_3DStyle.engineId).

model3D.description: The 3D model type: Block, Wireframe, Hidden Line or Shading, as the integer value of API_3DModelTypeID.

monochromeEnabled.description: The model is shown in monochrome colors.

monochromeSurfaceColor.description: The surface color of the monochrome model.

monochromeContourColor.description: The contour color of the monochrome model.

backgroundAsInRendering.description: The background is the same as in the rendering settings.

chainBackgroundColors.description: The sky and the ground background colors are chained.

backgroundSkyColor.description: The sky color of the background (API_3DStyle.bkgSkyColor).

shadingContours.description: The contours in shaded mode, as the integer value of API_ShadingContoursID.

vectorialSunShadow.description: The vectorial sun shadow options, as the integer value of API_VectorShadowID.

contourThickness.description: The thickness of the contours, in pixels.

silhouetteThickness.description: The thickness of the silhouettes, in pixels.

vectorialHatchingThickness.description: The thickness of the vectorial hatching, in pixels.

shadowContourThickness.description: The thickness of the shadow contours, in pixels.

castShadowPercent.description: The intensity of the cast shadows, in percent.

shadingPercent.description: The intensity of the shading, in percent.

shadowElevation.description: The elevation of the shadow plane, used by the one level vectorial sun shadow options.

SuccessfulExecutionResult.description: The result of a successful execution.

SunDateTime.description: The project's date and time (Options > Project Preferences > Location Settings), which Archicad calculates the sun position from.

daylightSaving.description: True when the time is daylight saving (summer) time.

SunDateTimeUpdate.description: The fields of the date and time to use instead of the project's; the fields left out keep the project's values.

daylightSaving.description: True when the time is daylight saving (summer) time.

SunLightSettings.description: The sun and ambient light settings of the project. Missing when Archicad cannot report them.

sunIntensity.description: The intensity of the sun light in percent.

ambientIntensity.description: The intensity of the ambient light in percent.

SunPosition.description: The position of the sun as Archicad calculates it from a date, time and location, in degrees.

azimuth.description: The sun azimuth in degrees: the direction of the sun in the project's XY plane, as the 3D Projection Settings show it.

altitude.description: The sun altitude in degrees: the elevation of the sun above the horizon, as the 3D Projection Settings show it.

SurfaceAttributeOrError.description: A surface attribute or an error.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing Surface to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

index.description: Index of the existing surface to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing surface with the given name will be overwritten.

SurfaceType.description: The type of a surface material.

positionInProject.description: The survey point's position in the project's coordinate system (Options > Project Preferences > Location Settings > Survey Point > Position). The map coordinates of the same point are in 'position'.

isVisible.description: Whether the survey point is shown in the project.

isLocked.description: Whether the survey point is locked, so it cannot be moved. Available from Archicad 26; left out on older versions.

eastings.description: Location along the easting of the coordinate system of the target map coordinate reference system.

northings.description: Location along the northing of the coordinate system of the target map coordinate reference system.

elevation.description: Orthogonal height relative to the vertical datum specified.

eastings.description: Location along the easting of the coordinate system of the target map coordinate reference system.

northings.description: Location along the northing of the coordinate system of the target map coordinate reference system.

elevation.description: Orthogonal height relative to the vertical datum specified.

positionInProject.description: The survey point's position in the project's coordinate system (Options > Project Preferences > Location Settings > Survey Point > Position). Moves the survey point in the project without changing its map coordinates in 'position'.

isVisible.description: Shows (true) or hides (false) the survey point. Omitted means unchanged.

isLocked.description: Locks (true) or unlocks (false) the survey point, so it cannot or can be moved. Omitted means unchanged. Available from Archicad 26; the command fails on older versions when it is given.

SymbolLabelTextDirection.description: Direction of the symbol label's text.

userName.description: The login name of the user.

isConnected.description: Whether the user has joined the project.

TextBoxAnchor.description: Anchor point of the text box.

elementId.description: A Text element or a Label of the Text class.

from.description: The position in the content where the replaced range starts.

range.description: The number of characters to replace; 0 inserts the content at 'from'. The range may not reach over a line end into another paragraph.

content.description: The new content of the range; an empty string deletes the range. It must not contain line ends.

TextDataWithRuns.description: The parameters of the new Text element.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

coordinate.description: The placement position of the text. The z value is used to determine the floor when floorIndex is omitted.

text.description: The text content. Newlines create multiple lines; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF. Ignored if 'runs' is also given.

runs.description: Multi-style text content: an array of styled runs, concatenated in order. Takes precedence over 'text' if both are given.

height.description: The character height in millimeters. Optional; defaults to the Text tool default. Equivalent to style.height.

pen.description: Optional pen attribute index. Equivalent to style.penIndex.

angle.description: Optional rotation angle in radians. Equivalent to style.angle.

style.description: height/pen/angle/justification above take precedence over the same fields here if both are given.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from the coordinate's z value.

layerIndex.description: Optional layer attribute index. If omitted, the Text tool default layer is used.

TextDataWithText.description: The parameters of the new Text element.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

coordinate.description: The placement position of the text. The z value is used to determine the floor when floorIndex is omitted.

text.description: The text content. Newlines create multiple lines; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF. Ignored if 'runs' is also given.

runs.description: Multi-style text content: an array of styled runs, concatenated in order. Takes precedence over 'text' if both are given.

height.description: The character height in millimeters. Optional; defaults to the Text tool default. Equivalent to style.height.

pen.description: Optional pen attribute index. Equivalent to style.penIndex.

angle.description: Optional rotation angle in radians. Equivalent to style.angle.

style.description: height/pen/angle/justification above take precedence over the same fields here if both are given.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from the coordinate's z value.

layerIndex.description: Optional layer attribute index. If omitted, the Text tool default layer is used.

text.description: The text content. Newlines separate the lines.

rawText.description: The text content as read with Archicad's autotext flag turned off, so an autotext shows its key (e.g. '<PROJECTNUMBER>') instead of its value. Present only when the flag could be switched for the read.

position.description: The placement position of the text.

angle.description: The rotation angle in radians (same as style.angle).

height.description: The character height in millimeters (same as style.height).

pen.description: The pen attribute index (same as style.penIndex).

zCoordinate.description: The level of the text's floor.

style.description: The flat fields above are the subset SetDetailsOfElements takes back.

paragraphCount.description: Read-only: number of paragraphs in the memo (Tapir's own Create/Modify commands always produce 1).

runs.description: The styled runs of the content, present whenever the content has paragraphs (always for content Tapir created); one entry per run, a single run too, as a run may carry a pen, font, face or size of its own. Concatenating the runs' text in order gives the full content.

TextFrameShape.description: Text frame shape. Standalone Text elements only support Rectangle. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as Rectangle.

length.description: The length of the longest line.

longestLineIndex.description: The zero-based index of the longest line (the first of them on a tie).

lineLengths.description: The length of every line, in order. An empty line is 0.

capitalSizeFactor.description: The ratio of the font's capital size to its typographic size. Absent when Archicad does not return it for the font.

text.description: The text to measure. Newlines separate lines, each measured on its own; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are treated as LF.

fontIndex.description: The index of the font, as GetDetailsOfElements and GetFontsByName report it in fontIndex. One of fontName and fontIndex is required.

fontName.description: Name of the font as Archicad's font list carries it (GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName), which is not always the operating system's font name; GetFontsByName tells whether a name is found. Resolved to the font's index (exact match first, then case-insensitive); the text fails when no loaded font has the name. Takes precedence over fontIndex if both are given. One of fontName and fontIndex is required.

height.description: The character height in millimetres, as a Text's height.

slant.description: The slant angle of the characters in radians; pi/2 (the default) is upright text.

inModelUnits.description: When true, Archicad applies the drawing scale correction and the lengths are model distances at the current drawing scale; when false (the default), they are lengths on paper in millimetres.

text.description: The text to measure. Newlines separate lines, each measured on its own; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are treated as LF.

fontIndex.description: The index of the font, as GetDetailsOfElements and GetFontsByName report it in fontIndex. One of fontName and fontIndex is required.

fontName.description: Name of the font as Archicad's font list carries it (GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName), which is not always the operating system's font name; GetFontsByName tells whether a name is found. Resolved to the font's index (exact match first, then case-insensitive); the text fails when no loaded font has the name. Takes precedence over fontIndex if both are given.
